roles.title: Orang Besar Istana, Honorary and Conferred Titles
roles.description: A holder of an honorary or palace title such as Orang Besar Istana or other royal honour in Malaysia is recognised for distinguished service, leadership or contributions to the nation or state; they may act in advisory, ceremonial or representative capacities during official royal functions, councils and cultural events, reflecting status and tradition rather than a paid employment role.
tasks: Serving as a member or advisor to the state ruler’s royal council in some states.
Participating in ceremonial duties and cultural or traditional ceremonies.
Representing the monarch at formal engagements when called upon.
Upholding the dignity and customs of the honour and acting as an exemplar in public life.
Offering guidance on matters of protocol, community service or heritage preservation as appropriate. Note: these are honorary and cultural duties not employment tasks.

skills.text: There are no formal “skill requirements” in an employment sense. Recipients are typically individuals with distinguished leadership, service, professional achievement, public contribution, or standing in the community. Skills relevant to representation, communication and cultural etiquette are beneficial.

No formalised job‑specific skills as understood in job markets. However, holders often demonstrate experience in community service, governance, diplomacy, public engagement, ceremony participation, and adherence to traditional protocols.

Walau bagaimanapun, pemegang jawatan ini biasanya menunjukkan pengalaman dalam khidmat masyarakat, tadbir urus, diplomasi, penglibatan awam, penyertaan dalam upacara, dan pematuhan kepada protokol tradisional.

roles.title: Wood Analyst
roles.description: Wood Analyst studies the structure and properties of wood to support sustainable forestry and wood-based industries. They examine and test wood samples to identify species, assess quality, analyse defects, and determine suitability for various applications. Their work includes developing strategies to conserve wood resources, improve utilisation and durability, and support timber processing, furniture manufacturing, and quality control, while minimising environmental impact.

Conduct physical, mechanical, and chemical tests to determine wood properties and performance.

Investigate the causes of wood defects and performance failure in timber products and materials.

roles.title: Animal Scientist
roles.description: Animal Scientist conduct research on the biology, genetics, nutrition, reproduction, and development of domestic farm animals to improve the production of meat, poultry, eggs, and milk. They study animal health and welfare, develop methods to enhance growth, reproduction, and disease resistance, and provide guidance to farmers and agricultural enterprises on effective animal management and sustainable livestock practices.

roles.title: Environmental Research Scientist
roles.description: Environmental Research Scientist conducts research to assess and mitigate the impact of human activities on the environment and public health. They study air, water, soil, and ecosystems, analyse environmental data, and develop strategies for pollution control, conservation, and sustainable resource management. Their work supports environmental policy, sustainable development, and natural resource preservation, often involving fieldwork, research, and collaboration with government agencies, industries, and communities.
tasks: Plan and conduct field and laboratory research to monitor air, water, soil, biodiversity, and ecosystem health.
Collect samples and analyse environmental and ecological data to evaluate changes and impacts.
Conduct surveys and studies of wildlife, plants, insects, and other organisms to support environmental assessment, and maintain related biological records and databases.
Design and support environmental impact assessments, conservation projects, and restoration initiatives through scientific research and analysis.
Evaluate the effects of pollution, land use changes, and human activities on natural habitats and species.
Develop and recommend strategies for environmental conservation, remediation, and sustainable management.

roles.title: Conservation Officer
roles.description: Conservation Officer studies and manages natural ecosystems to ensure the sustainable use and preservation of forests, wildlife, and other natural resources. They assess the impact of human activities, pollution, and climate change, conduct research on forest ecology and environmental processes, and develop strategies for conservation, restoration, and sustainable management. Their role involves fieldwork, policy implementation, monitoring, and collaboration with government agencies, environmental organisations, and communities to balance ecological protection with responsible resource use.
tasks: Plan and conduct applied field research and ecological assessments to study forests, wildlife, and ecosystems.
Develop, implement, and evaluate conservation, forest management, and restoration plans.

roles.title: Biochemist
roles.description: Biochemist studies the chemical and physical principles of living organisms and biological processes to advance knowledge in medicine, agriculture, and environmental science. They conduct experiments to understand cellular and molecular functions, including metabolism, growth, heredity, protein and enzyme activity, and the effects of substances such as drugs, hormones, and foods. Their work involves analysing biological samples, developing new products or drugs, improving diagnostic methods, and applying biochemical knowledge to solve practical problems across healthcare, biotechnology, and industrial applications.

roles.title: Physiologist

Their work contributes to healthcare, veterinary medicine, pharmaceuticals, and public health by ensuring safe and effective use of chemical and biological agents.

roles.title: Marine Engineer
roles.description: Marine Engineer is responsible for the design, operation, maintenance, and repair of mechanical, electrical, and electronic systems on ships and marine vessels. This includes propulsion systems, auxiliary machinery, power generation units, and other critical onboard equipment. They ensure that all systems function safely, efficiently, and in compliance with maritime regulations, oversee technical operations, manage engineering crews, and perform emergency repairs to maintain the seaworthiness of the vessel and the safety of its crew and cargo.
tasks: Design, install, inspect, diagnose, and maintain propulsion, auxiliary, and other ship machinery and onboard mechanical, electrical, and electronic systems.
Supervise and manage the engineering team to ensure efficient and safe ship operations.
Ensure compliance with maritime regulations, safety standards, and environmental conventions.
Manage fuel consumption, bunkering operations, and onboard energy efficiency.
Coordinate repairs, refits, technical tests, and emergency responses for ship machinery and systems.
Maintain accurate operational records, logs, and engineering documentation.
Provide technical advice during vessel construction, modifications, and dry docking activities.
Collaborate with naval architects, shipyards, and other professionals on vessel operations and maintenance.

skills.text: Critical thinking and analytical skills to diagnose and solve complex mechanical problems.

roles.title: Naval Architect
roles.description: Naval Architect is responsible for designing, constructing, maintaining, and repairing marine vessels and structures, including ships, submarines, yachts, ferries, and offshore platforms. They apply engineering principles to ensure vessels are safe, efficient, stable, and environmentally sustainable, considering hull form, structure, stability, resistance, and propulsion. Their work integrates mechanical, electrical, and structural systems, often collaborating with marine engineers and other specialists throughout the vessel’s lifecycle.
tasks: Develop detailed designs and plans for marine vessels and structures in compliance with technical, safety, and regulatory standards.
Conduct hydrostatic, hydrodynamic, and structural calculations to assess vessel stability, resistance, propulsion, and overall performance.
Simulate and evaluate vessel behaviour using Computer-Aided Design (CAD) and engineering software to support design validation.
Collaborate with construction teams and other specialists to ensure vessel designs are accurately implemented during construction.
Provide technical advice on vessel performance, safety, stability, and design efficiency throughout the vessel lifecycle.
Oversee vessel modifications and retrofits to ensure continued compliance, safety, and performance improvement.
Ensure vessel and marine structure designs comply with international maritime standards and classification requirements.

skills.text: Active listening and sound decision-making to support engineering judgments.

Good written and verbal communication skills for reporting and team collaboration.
Strong analytical and critical thinking skills to interpret technical data and solve engineering problems.

roles.title: Hovercraft Pilot
roles.description: Hovercraft Pilot is responsible for the safe and efficient operation of hovercrafts over water, land, ice, and mud. They navigate varying terrains and weather conditions, ensure the safety of passengers or cargo, monitor and operate onboard systems, and maintain communication with control stations, making real-time decisions to ensure secure operations. They may also oversee vessel navigation and related duties while in port.
tasks: Conduct pre-departure inspections of the hovercraft, including basic checks of structural condition and onboard systems, to ensure operational readiness.
Navigate and command the hovercraft safely along assigned routes.

Carry out safety procedures and respond to emergencies in accordance with operational requirements.
Record operational activities, incidents and voyage details accurately for reporting and review.

skills.text: Ability to interpret and respond to changing environmental and weather conditions.

roles.description: Port Captain is responsible for supervising and coordinating vessel operations at ports or terminals, ensuring compliance with national and international regulations. The role oversees cargo handling, port logistics, and operational efficiency while maintaining safety standards, acting as a key liaison between shipping companies, port authorities, and vessel crews to ensure the safe and timely arrival, departure, and handling of ships.

The role involves planning routes, interpreting weather conditions, operating navigational equipment, and supervising crew to maintain the vessel’s operational integrity. The position focuses on safe passage, hazard avoidance, and the accurate documentation of voyages.

roles.title: Shipping Executive
roles.description: Shipping Executive is responsible for managing and coordinating the full shipping and logistics processes, ensuring the timely dispatch and delivery of goods while maintaining accurate documentation for local and international shipments. They liaise with freight forwarders and logistics providers, ensure compliance with customs and regulatory requirements, and resolve delivery or scheduling issues. The role also involves optimising shipment workflows, maintaining shipping records, and coordinating with internal departments, while representing the ship owner in foreign ports to oversee necessary formalities.

The role also involves responding effectively to in-flight emergencies, keeping accurate flight records, and staying updated on safety procedures and regulatory changes.

tasks: Collecting and processing general, economic, sports, exclusive, and other news.
Preparing news reports.

skills.text: Ability to write and prepare reports effectively.
Analytical skills.
Computer skills.
Good communication skills.

roles.title: Translator
roles.description: Translator converts written or spoken content from one language to another, ensuring that the original meaning, tone and nuances are accurately conveyed and culturally appropriate. They work with a wide range of materials, including technical, legal, commercial, literary and audiovisual texts, and may adapt dialogue into synchronised subtitles for media productions. The role also involves researching terminology, compiling and updating language references such as dictionary entries, and reviewing translated texts to maintain linguistic accuracy, clarity and consistency.
tasks: Translate written documents and multimedia content accurately from a source language to a target language.
Review, proofread, and edit translated content for grammar, clarity, style, accuracy, and consistency.
Adapt translated content to suit cultural, regional, and audience-specific contexts while preserving the original meaning and tone.
Use computer-assisted translation tools, translation memory software, and terminology resources to ensure consistency.
Research industry-specific and specialised terminology to support accurate translation.
Translate and synchronise subtitles or scripts for audiovisual media such as films, television, and documentaries.
Collaborate with clients, colleagues, or project teams to clarify requirements and maintain the intended meaning of the source content.
Compile, update, or validate dictionary entries, glossaries, or other language reference materials as needed.
Translate spoken content orally in discussions or meetings when required.
Manage assigned translation workflows, schedules, and quality checks to ensure timely and accurate delivery.

skills.text: Attention to detail to ensure accurate translations, definitions, and text adaptation.
Critical thinking, reading comprehension, and analytical skills for understanding complex texts and word usage.
Cultural awareness and sensitivity to adapt content appropriately.
Effective time management, multitasking, and ability to meet tight deadlines.
Strong command of at least two languages, with excellent reading, writing, grammar, and communication skills.
Ability to conduct linguistic, subject-specific, and cultural research.
Expertise in lexicography, dictionary compilation, and terminology management.
Knowledge in audiovisual translation, subtitling standards, and timing conventions.
Knowledge in semantics, language structure, and linguistic analysis.
Knowledge in specialised fields such as legal, medical, commercial, technical, or literary translation.
Proficiency in computer-assisted translation (CAT), translation memory, corpus linguistics, and subtitling tools.
Proficiency in proofreading, editing, and translation quality assurance.

roles.title: Interpreter
roles.description: Interpreter converts spoken or signed communication from one language to another in real time, ensuring that the original meaning, tone and context are accurately conveyed to facilitate clear understanding between parties. They may work in settings such as healthcare, legal proceedings, business, conferences and community services, supporting effective communication across language barriers. In some roles, they also apply advanced linguistic knowledge to analyse language structure and usage, contribute to translation and localisation activities, and support language-related research or technology development.
tasks: Listen to spoken or signed communication and interpret it accurately into another language in real time or after short pauses.
Convey tone, emotion, intent, and cultural nuances accurately during interpretation.
Research and apply subject-specific terminology to support accurate interpretation.
Use specialised equipment and remote interpreting platforms for simultaneous, consecutive, or remote interpretation, and provide sight translation of short written materials when required.
Maintain strict confidentiality, neutrality, and professional conduct in all interpreting sessions.
Conduct linguistic research and analyse language usage and cultural context to improve interpretation quality and support translation or localisation activities when required.
Document interpretation sessions and support language-related projects as required.

skills.text: Active listening and ability to retain and recall information.
Attention to detail and cultural awareness or sensitivity.
Critical thinking and analytical ability to understand context and deliver accurate meaning.
Strong command of at least two languages, with excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Time management and ability to work effectively under pressure or in a team.
Ability to apply cultural context and language nuances to ensure clear and accurate communication.
Ability to interpret in multiple modes, including simultaneous and consecutive interpreting.
Ability to maintain confidentiality, neutrality, and professional ethics in interpreting practice.
Competency in linguistic research and language analysis to support interpreting quality and related language activities.
Knowledge in industry-specific terminology, especially in medical, legal, and technical contexts.
Knowledge in linguistics, including syntax, phonetics, semantics, and morphology, to support accurate interpretation.
Proficiency in interpreting software, remote interpreting platforms, and digital communication tools.
Proficiency in note-taking, shorthand, and session documentation for interpreting purposes.

roles.title: Interpreter Grade LA5
roles.description: Interpreter Grade LA5 in addition to providing verbal interpretation in open court, the Interpreter fully assists the quorum members (Magistrates, Sessions Court Judges, and High Court Judges) in managing cases from pre-trial proceedings, during hearings, through to post-trial processes.
tasks: Translating cases for defendants, witnesses, lawyers, and judges requiring interpretation.
Reading charges, case facts, probation reports, and other documents to defendants/accused in a language they understand during court sessions.
Announcing or calling cases for mention, hearing, and judgement, and scheduling new dates for such cases.
Administering oaths and obtaining personal details of witnesses during open court proceedings.
Receiving and registering new cases in the Court Register Book and recording case details in the Daily Log, Court Diaries, and Exhibit Book.
Preparing the Daily Court Report (statistics).
Managing charge sheets for cases that have been concluded in final series files.

skills.text: Language skills.
Computer skills.
Knowledge of relevant acts and laws.

Reading charges, case facts, probation reports, and other documents to defendants/accused in a language they understand during court sessions.
Announcing or calling cases for mention, hearing, and judgement, and scheduling new dates for such cases.

Receiving and registering new cases in the Court Register Book and recording case details in the Daily Log, Court Diaries, and Exhibit Book.
Preparing the Daily Court Report (statistics).
Managing charge sheets for cases that have been concluded in final series files.

skills.text: Language skills.
Computer skills.
Knowledge of relevant acts and laws.

roles.title: Sculptor
roles.description: Sculptor creates three-dimensional artwork by shaping a material such as stone, clay, wood, glass, plaster, or a synthetic substance. They interpret artistic concepts or client briefs and transform them into tangible forms using manual or digital techniques, producing standalone pieces, contributing to set and prop design, or developing structural displays for public and commercial spaces.
tasks: Interpret sculptural ideas from sketches, artistic concepts, or client briefs into three-dimensional forms.
Select and prepare appropriate materials such as wood, stone, metal, clay, glass, plaster, or synthetic substances.
Shape and form sculptures using carving, moulding, casting, or assembling techniques.
Refine and finish sculpture surfaces for presentation, display, or installation.
Install sculptures for exhibitions, public displays, commercial spaces, or permanent structures.
Collaborate with clients, designers, or architects to achieve artistic and functional requirements.
Develop representational or abstract sculptural designs, styles, and themes using traditional or digital methods.
Ensure sculptures meet safety, structural, and aesthetic requirements.
Coordinate sculptural project work from concept development to final installation.

skills.text: Creativity and an artistic mindset to develop original and expressive sculptures.
Critical thinking and active listening to understand project requirements and solve problems.
Effective communication and teamwork to collaborate with clients and colleagues.
Strong visual-spatial awareness and manual dexterity for precise work.
Time management and attention to detail to meet deadlines and maintain quality.
Ability to adapt traditional sculpting techniques to modern applications, including public installations and commercial displays.
Ability to use related software for concept visualisation, design planning, and presentation.
Knowledge in working with sculptural materials such as stone, clay, wood, metal, plaster, resin, and fibreglass.
Proficiency in digital sculpting software.
Proficiency in finishing processes, including sanding, patination, and painting.
Proficiency in sculpting techniques, including carving, modelling, welding, and casting.

roles.title: Artist
roles.description: Artist creates original visual artworks by applying artistic concepts and techniques across mediums such as painting, drawing, sculpture, engraving or digital formats. They develop and interpret ideas into finished works, selecting appropriate materials and methods to achieve intended aesthetic or conceptual outcomes. They may specialise in particular styles or themes and present their work through exhibitions, commissions or other public platforms within the visual arts sector.
tasks: Create original visual artworks using techniques such as painting, drawing, sculpture, or related artistic media.
Develop creative concepts and distinctive personal styles for visual artworks.
Produce artworks based on client commissions or personal artistic expression.
Manage time, materials, and resources to complete artworks efficiently.
Coordinate with galleries, museums, and festivals to exhibit artworks.
Promote and sell artworks to buyers, clients, or the public.
Participate in or lead workshops, talks, or artistic demonstrations.
Apply for grants, residencies, exhibitions, or other artistic opportunities.
Plan promotional and creative activities to support the commercial viability of artworks.
Continuously improve artistic skills and techniques.

skills.text: Attention to detail to ensure high-quality and polished output.
Creativity and artistic thinking to develop unique and engaging artworks.
Critical thinking and adaptability to solve problems and respond to changing needs.
Effective communication and teamwork with clients and peers.
Time management to meet deadlines and manage multiple projects.
Ability to apply sculpting techniques and three-dimensional form development in artistic works.
Knowledge in colour theory, composition, and visual storytelling.
Proficiency in digital art software.
Proficiency in texturing techniques to create depth and surface detail in artworks.

roles.title: Musicologist
roles.description: Musicologist studies music academically, examining its history, theory, structure, and cultural context. They analyse a composition, document a musical tradition, and contribute to research, often specialising in a particular genre, period, or region. Their work typically involves publishing findings, teaching, and supporting a cultural or scholarly organisation such as a university, research centre, or music archive.
tasks: Conduct research on musical genres, traditions, and historical periods.
Analyse musical scores, recordings, and compositions.
Write, edit, and publish academic papers, articles, or books on music.
Teach music theory, history, or musical analysis at educational institutions.
Deliver lectures and presentations at seminars, workshops, or conferences.
Collaborate with researchers, musicians, and cultural institutions.
Contribute to music archives, documentation, or preservation projects.
Participate in interdisciplinary cultural or music-related research initiatives.

skills.text: Ability to conduct detailed research and analysis.
Basic digital literacy for data collection and documentation.
Critical thinking, active listening, and attention to detail.
Effective written and verbal communication skills.
Strong time management and organisational skills.
Ability to analyse and critically evaluate musical works.
Competency in academic writing and publication in music studies.
Competency in music archiving, cataloguing, and preservation.
Expertise in qualitative and quantitative research methods in music.
Knowledge in music theory, music history, and global music traditions.
Knowledge in the cultural significance of music across historical and regional contexts.
Proficiency in music notation and transcription software.

roles.title: Instrumentalist
roles.description: Instrumentalist performs, composes, arranges, and adapts a musical work on one or more instruments, participating in a live or recorded performance individually or with an ensemble or orchestra. They interpret a musical score, rehearse to maintain technical proficiency, and collaborate with a conductor, composer, and fellow musician. In addition, some specialise in traditional music, preserving, performing, and teaching cultural heritage through formal programmes or institutions.
tasks: Set up and prepare musical instruments for rehearsals and performances.
Compose, arrange, and adapt musical works for specific instruments, ensembles, or occasions.
Perform individually or with an ensemble or orchestra in live or recorded performances.
Rehearse and perform with other musicians to maintain technical proficiency and performance quality.
Assist in selecting musical pieces and preparing music-related activities for performances.
Teach, mentor, and guide students or apprentices in musical performance, including traditional forms.
Preserve and transmit traditional musical heritage through performance and training.
Participate in programmes or activities that promote musical and cultural heritage.

skills.text: Ability to read and interpret musical notation, scores, and performance instructions.
Attention to detail and proficiency in using diagnostic tools.
Critical thinking and effective decision-making.
Good communication and teamwork skills.
Strong musical performance skills, including proficiency in playing one or more instruments with accuracy, rhythm, and expression.
Ability to mentor and instruct students or apprentices in music and cultural arts.
Ability to perform effectively in ensembles and orchestras.
Competency in preserving, teaching, and transmitting musical and cultural heritage.
Knowledge in music theory, composition, and arrangement.
Knowledge in musical performance practice and ensemble standards.
Proficiency in playing traditional and modern musical instruments.
Proficiency in reading and interpreting music notation in written and oral traditions.

roles.title: Adiguru - Shadow Puppet Theatre
roles.description: Adiguru - Shadow Puppet Theatre creates and performs traditional shadow puppet shows by narrating cultural stories, manipulating intricately crafted leather puppets, composing and arranging accompanying music, and playing traditional instruments such as the gamelan. They also mentor apprentices, ensuring the transmission of skills and knowledge, and play a key role in preserving and promoting Malaysia’s intangible cultural heritage.
tasks: Compose and perform traditional Wayang Kulit narratives.
Design, craft and maintain leather shadow puppets for performances.
Perform Wayang Kulit shows with coordinated traditional musical accompaniment.
Compose and arrange traditional music, and coordinate accompanying performers and musical instruments for performances.
Mentor and train apprentices in Wayang Kulit arts.
Conduct workshops and educational activities on Wayang Kulit for the public.
Adapt stories and music to suit different audiences and occasions.
Participate in cultural festivals and heritage exhibitions.
Promote and preserve Wayang Kulit through community engagement and public outreach.

skills.text: Active listening and cultural sensitivity.
Effective communication in widely used languages.
Public speaking and coordination skills.
Storytelling and engaging audiences of different ages and backgrounds.
Time management and critical thinking.
Ability to mentor and train apprentices in Wayang Kulit arts.
Competency in music composition and arrangement for performances.
Competency in preserving and promoting Wayang Kulit through community and educational engagement.
Craftsmanship in leather shadow puppet creation and maintenance.
Expert-level shadow puppet manipulation.
Mastery of traditional storytelling techniques and Wayang Kulit narrative traditions.
Proficiency in traditional musical accompaniment for Wayang Kulit, including instruments such as gongs and drums.

roles.title: Composer/Orchestrator
roles.description: Composer/Orchestrator creates and arranges a musical work for performance, transforming an original composition into a full score and adapting music for different instruments, voices, or styles. They collaborate with a performer, producer, and director to ensure the composition meets artistic and performance requirements, and may work across media such as live performances, film, television, and video games. The role combines creative musical composition with technical orchestration to deliver a cohesive and expressive musical piece.
tasks: Compose original musical works for performances or media.
Adapt, arrange, and orchestrate music for different instruments, voices, ensembles, or styles.
Transcribe, edit, and prepare readable musical scores and parts using music notation software.
Collaborate with directors, producers, conductors, and performers to ensure compositions meet artistic and performance requirements.
Document musical compositions, arrangements, and orchestration materials clearly for performance or production use.

skills.text: Active listening and attention to detail in musical composition and arrangement.
Coordination and teamwork in creative and cross-functional environments.
Critical thinking and effective decision-making.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, including multilingual capability.
Time management and the ability to handle multiple priorities.
Ability to adapt music for media productions, including film, television, games, and advertising.
Ability to compose and arrange music across various genres and formats.
Knowledge in orchestration, harmony, polyphony, and sight-reading.

roles.title: Music Director
roles.description: Music Director leads and coordinates a musical ensemble, including an orchestra, band, or choir, during rehearsals, recording sessions, and live performances. They interpret a musical score, select and organise compositions, guide musicians to ensure a cohesive and high-quality performance, and shape the overall artistic expression of the music. Their role combines musical expertise, leadership, and organisational skills to manage both the artistic and operational aspects of a performance.
tasks: Plan and coordinate rehearsals, recording sessions, and live performances for the orchestra, band, or choir.
Select, organise, arrange, and adapt musical compositions for the ensemble and performance context.
Conduct rehearsals, recording sessions, and live performances by interpreting musical scores and guiding musical expression, tempo, and dynamics.
Audition, select, and direct musicians and singers for performances.
Collaborate with composers, arrangers, soloists, vocalists, and technical teams to support artistic and performance requirements.
Guide musicians to achieve cohesive, high-quality performances in line with the artistic vision.
Evaluate performance standards and make musical adjustments to improve overall interpretation and presentation.
Organise rehearsal schedules and manage logistical arrangements related to performances.

skills.text: Ability to read and interpret musical scores with a solid foundation in music theory.
Active listening and effective coordination with diverse teams.
Critical thinking and decision-making under performance pressure.
Planning, organisational, and time-management skills.
Strong leadership and communication skills.
Ability to arrange and adapt music for different ensembles and performance settings.
Ability to direct and guide musicians and singers to achieve cohesive ensemble performance.
Ability to evaluate musical performance quality and align interpretation with artistic vision.
Advanced knowledge of music theory, score interpretation, and instrumentation.
Competency in rehearsal planning, performance preparation, and musical interpretation.
Proficiency in conducting techniques and gesture vocabulary.
Proficiency in interpreting diverse musical genres, styles, and performance techniques.
Proficiency in music notation software and basic recording or digital rehearsal tools.

roles.title: Singer
roles.description: Singer performs vocal music across live, recorded, or streamed platforms, interpreting and delivering lyrics for audiences. They may work as soloists, in choirs, ensembles, opera, or musical theatre, and are responsible for rehearsing, maintaining vocal technique, and collaborating with other performers to create cohesive musical presentations.
tasks: Read, interpret, and perform song lyrics during live, recorded, or streamed performances.
Rehearse, prepare for, and perform songs individually or as part of a group.
Record vocals in studios or for online performance platforms.
Perform in live streams and engage with audiences on digital platforms.
Collaborate with producers, musicians, and other artists to deliver cohesive musical performances.
Continuously improve vocal skills and performance techniques.
Perform as a solo artist, choir member, backup singer, or in musical theatre.

skills.text: Active listening and effective communication.
Multilingual proficiency and interpersonal skills.
Stage presence and performance skills.
Strong vocal abilities.
Time management and self-discipline.
Ability to engage audiences through live performances and digital streaming platforms.

Ability to perform and interpret songs across various musical genres.

Proficiency in vocal training techniques to develop and maintain voice quality.

roles.description: Musician Grade B9 (Assistant Principal) responsible in composing songs, playing a musical instrument for training and performances, being a member of an orchestra and leading the orchestra.

roles.description: Musician Grade B10 (Senior Principal) responsible in composing songs, playing a musical instrument for training and performances, being a member of an orchestra and leading the orchestra.

roles.title: Musician Grade B12 (Assistant Conductor of the National Symphony Orchestra)
roles.description: Musician Grade B12 (Assistant Conductor of the National Symphony Orchestra) responsible in composing songs, playing a musical instrument for training and performances, being a member of an orchestra and leading the orchestra.
tasks: Possessing specialised expertise in classical music, with extensive experience in leading a Professional Symphony Orchestra, alongside the ability to compose and analyse music.
Reporting to the Director General of Istana Budaya and the Music Director/Conductor of the National Symphony Orchestra.
Assisting the National Symphony Orchestra Conductor in rehearsals and musical performances.
Supporting music composition tasks and repertoire planning.
Serving as one of the planners for music arts programmes and as Conductor of the National Youth Symphony Orchestra of Malaysia.
Striving to develop and elevate the orchestra’s performance to a distinguished standard and enhance the quality of national musical performances.
Continuously monitoring the skills and competencies of orchestra members.

skills.text: Musical instrument performance skills.

roles.description: Musician Grade B13, B14 (Conductor of the National Symphony Orchestra) responsible in composing songs, playing a musical instrument for training and performances, being a member of an orchestra and leading the orchestra.

roles.title: Dancer
roles.description: Dancer interprets ideas, emotions, stories, or characters through movement and body language, often to music, for audiences in live performances, theatre, television, music videos, or nightlife venues. They perform choreographed works or improvise when required, collaborating closely with choreographers, directors, and other performers, and maintain high physical fitness through regular rehearsals and training. The role focuses on expressing artistic or thematic concepts while entertaining and engaging audiences.
tasks: Learn and rehearse choreographed dance routines regularly.
Perform dance routines for audiences in live or recorded performance settings.
Collaborate with choreographers, directors, and fellow performers during rehearsals and performances.
Maintain physical fitness, costumes, and personal appearance to support performance readiness.
Participate in auditions, rehearsals, and promotional activities related to performances.
Contribute to the adaptation of choreography when required.
Improvise or perform related movement-based duties when required.

roles.title: Choreographer
roles.description: Choreographer designs, creates, and refines a dance sequence for a performance, class, event, or digital media, ensuring movements are expressive, coordinated, and aligned with artistic vision. They teach and coach dancers, guide rehearsals, and may oversee the instructional and artistic direction of a dance programme, collaborating with a director, performer, and production team to deliver a cohesive and engaging performance.
tasks: Design, create, and refine dance routines for performances, classes, events, or digital media, ensuring movements are expressive, coordinated, and aligned with the artistic vision.
Collaborate with directors, performers, and production teams to align choreography with music, themes, costumes, lighting, and overall performance requirements.
Teach and rehearse choreography with dancers or students, adapting instruction to different dance styles and skill levels.
Guide dancers in preparation for performances, classes, assessments, competitions, or events, and provide constructive feedback to improve performance quality.
Plan and coordinate rehearsals, including scheduling, venue readiness, and communication with dancers.
Lead and coach dancers or instructors to achieve artistic, instructional, and performance standards.
Develop lesson plans and teaching strategies to support dance instruction and programme delivery for different skill levels.

skills.text: Creativity and artistic sense for choreography and performance planning.
Leadership and ability to manage and coordinate groups.
Physical stamina, coordination, and timing for dance demonstration and refinement.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
Time management, organisation, and problem-solving for planning, rehearsals, and execution.

Knowledge in music, rhythm, and dance interpretation for expressive and coordinated movement design.

roles.title: Producer (Film, Stage and Multimedia)
roles.description: Producer (Film, Stage and Multimedia) plans, coordinates and manages the production of film, stage and multimedia content, including documentaries, commercials, live performances and digital media. They oversee the full production process from concept development and script preparation to budgeting, scheduling and engagement of creative and technical personnel, ensuring artistic, technical and logistical elements are effectively integrated. They are accountable for delivering productions that meet quality standards, timelines and intended audience objectives across relevant platforms.
tasks: Develop and manage production schedules, budgets, and timelines for multimedia, stage, or film projects.
Coordinate with directors, writers, actors, designers, and technical teams to ensure smooth collaboration.
Oversee the creative and technical aspects of production, including scripts, storyboards, casting, design, sound, lighting, and overall visual or performance quality.
Plan and organise rehearsals, technical setups, and logistical arrangements such as venues and equipment.
Monitor team progress, provide feedback, and resolve production issues to keep projects on schedule and to required quality standards.
Review and finalise multimedia, stage, or film productions to ensure they meet project goals and audience objectives.
Manage contracts, royalties, and related administrative or reporting tasks.
Stay updated with industry trends, technologies, and best practices to enhance production outcomes.

skills.text: Active listening and coordination to work with teams and stakeholders.
Creativity and adaptability in dynamic and high-pressure environments.
Critical thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making to handle challenges effectively.
Effective time management and organisational abilities to meet deadlines and coordinate multiple priorities.
Strong communication, collaboration, and interpersonal skills.
Ability to coordinate live events, stagecraft, and technical production requirements.
Competency in budgeting, financial planning, and resource management for productions.
Competency in integrating creative and technical production elements, including audio-visual systems and live streaming.
Competency in planning and managing multimedia productions across film, stage, and digital platforms.
Knowledge in health, safety, and compliance standards in production environments.
Knowledge in video production, post-production, and content finalisation workflows.
Proficiency in production-related software for scheduling, coordination, and content review.

roles.title: Director (Film, Stage and Media)
roles.description: Director (Film, Stage and Media) is responsible for overseeing and shaping the creative and visual aspects of a production, including a film, documentary, or stage performance. They manage the overall look, feel, and flow of the production by coordinating camera operations, lighting, set design, casting, rehearsals, and performance execution. They collaborate closely with actors, crew, and production teams to translate scripts and concepts into compelling, cohesive, and visually engaging storytelling.
tasks: Collaborate with creative teams to define the visual style and overall direction of productions.
Plan and oversee camera angles, movements, and lighting setups for each scene or performance.
Direct rehearsals, actors, and performers to achieve desired artistic outcomes.
Manage production schedules, timelines, and budgets to ensure timely delivery.
Oversee set, costume, sound, and other technical departments to ensure alignment with the director’s vision.
Conduct research, contribute to script or storyboard development, and guide narrative structure.
Supervise filming or live recording processes, including coordination of camera crews and use of technical equipment.

Ensure compliance with ethical, legal, and safety standards throughout production.

Organisational and time management skills to plan, schedule, and meet production deadlines.

Ability to develop and maintain a unified creative vision across film, stage, and multimedia productions.
Ability to direct actors and stage performers, including stage blocking and performance guidance.
Competency in integrating animation and illustration into storyboarding and concept development.
Competency in managing production budgets, schedules, and crew operations.
Expertise in lighting techniques for varied moods, scenes, and visual styles.
Knowledge in stagecraft, set design, sound, and multimedia production elements.
Knowledge in video composition, colour theory, and post-production processes including colour grading.
Proficiency in photography and videography for production and promotional purposes.
Proficiency in professional camera systems and filming equipment.
Proficiency in video editing and motion graphics software.

roles.title: Television/Radio Technical Director
roles.description: Television/Radio Technical Director oversees and coordinates all technical aspects of a broadcast production, including a live or recorded programme. They manage technical departments such as engineering, taping, editing, and maintenance, ensuring seamless integration of audio, video, lighting, and transmission systems. They work closely with production teams to deliver high-quality content across television and radio platforms.
tasks: Plan, coordinate, and implement the technical aspects of live and recorded broadcasts.
Supervise technical staff and coordinate smooth daily operations across technical departments.
Ensure audio, video, lighting, and transmission equipment is functional and complies with broadcasting standards.
Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues during broadcast operations promptly and effectively.
Collaborate with creative teams to maintain high production quality.
Analyse technical problems and evaluate suitable solutions to maintain broadcast continuity.
Interpret and apply technical manuals, operational documents, and broadcasting standards.
Coordinate and optimise workflow across engineering, recording, editing, and maintenance departments.

skills.text: Coordination and active listening skills.
Critical thinking and problem-solving skills.
Effective communication and collaboration skills.

roles.description: Horticulture Technician supports the planning, cultivation, and maintenance of a wide range of plants, including flowers, vegetables, fruits, and field crops, in a nursery, farm, or research setting. They conduct soil and crop assessments, monitor plant health and growth conditions, implement pest and disease management, and assist in irrigation, fertilisation, and propagation activities, working closely with agronomists, horticulturists, and agricultural scientists to contribute to research, the development of improved cultivation techniques, and the promotion of sustainable and productive agricultural practices.
tasks: Conduct soil preparation, testing, and amendment to support optimal plant growth.
Propagate plants through sowing, cuttings, grafting, and transplanting seedlings.
Apply fertilisers, pesticides, and other treatments safely to maintain plant health.
Operate and maintain irrigation systems and horticultural machinery.
Monitor plant growth, health, and development, and identify pests, diseases, and nutrient deficiencies.
Prune, trim, and manage plants to promote healthy development and maintain appearance.
Collect and prepare soil, plant, and crop samples, and assist in analysing them for research and quality assessment.
Assist in crop trials, plant breeding, and development programmes to support yield and variety improvement.
Maintain accurate records of plant inventories, treatments, environmental conditions, and crop progress.
Collaborate with farmers, researchers, and other personnel to support implementation of good horticultural practices and compliance with safety standards.

skills.text: Analytical and problem-solving abilities to interpret field and laboratory data and address crop or horticultural challenges.
Basic numeracy, literacy, and computer skills for data recording, measurements, reporting, and using relevant agricultural tools or technology.
Effective verbal and written communication skills for collaborating with team members, supervisors, farmers, and stakeholders.
Physical stamina and manual dexterity to perform outdoor tasks, handle equipment, and manage repetitive or delicate horticultural work.
Strong observational skills and attention to detail for monitoring plant health, growth, and environmental conditions.
Ability to support crop and plant monitoring, field trials, and agronomic research activities.
Competency in operating and maintaining horticultural and agricultural equipment, irrigation systems, and greenhouse climate control systems.
Competency in using Geographic Information System (GIS) and precision agriculture tools for farm mapping and monitoring.
Knowledge in local plant species, crops, and climate-specific horticultural practices.
Knowledge in soil science, fertility management, and soil testing for plant and crop growth optimisation.

roles.title: Irrigation Technician
roles.description: Irrigation Technician operates, monitors, and maintains an irrigation system to provide optimal water supply for crops, plants, or landscapes. They plan and set up irrigation layouts, assess soil moisture, schedule watering cycles according to climate and crop needs, and troubleshoot equipment, ensuring efficient and sustainable water use, while collaborating with agricultural or landscaping teams and complying with environmental regulations.
tasks: Set up, operate, adjust, and maintain irrigation systems and equipment including sprinklers, drip systems, pumps, valves, water lines, and related components.
Monitor water flow, pressure, soil moisture, and weather conditions to ensure efficient irrigation coverage and system performance.
Perform routine inspections, preventive maintenance, and minor repairs on irrigation systems and equipment.
Conduct soil sampling and assess soil and vegetation conditions to determine irrigation requirements.
Coordinate with farm managers or supervisors to optimise irrigation plans, and record irrigation schedules, water usage, and system performance.

skills.text: Ability to read and interpret irrigation schematics and system diagrams.
Communication and teamwork skills to coordinate effectively with staff.
Manual dexterity for handling equipment adjustments and repairs.
Problem-solving skills to troubleshoot system failures and make adjustments.
Understanding of mechanical and electrical systems used in irrigation.

roles.title: Farming Technician (Animal Production)
roles.description: Farming Technician (Animal Production) oversees and manages the health, welfare, and productivity of livestock, including dairy cattle and poultry, on a farm or processing facility. They monitor animal health, administer treatments, implement feeding and breeding practices, and ensure compliance with hygiene, biosecurity, and regulatory standards, conducting routine tests, quality checks, and data collection to support disease control, herd performance, and scientific research, providing technical guidance to farm staff and contributing to agricultural development.
tasks: Daily inspection and care of livestock to monitor health, detect illness or injury, and ensure animal welfare.
Administer vaccinations and medications in accordance with veterinary instructions to maintain herd health.
Operate and maintain milking systems and farm machinery to ensure efficient and safe functioning.
Collect biological samples such as milk, blood, and other specimens, and conduct basic testing and analysis for health monitoring.
Monitor animal productivity and health, and record and analyse farm data to support herd management decisions.
Assist in breeding programmes and selective breeding activities to improve livestock genetics and productivity.
Design and implement feeding programmes to ensure appropriate nutrition across different growth stages of livestock.
Implement biosecurity, hygiene, and disease prevention measures to maintain farm health and safety standards.
Train and supervise farm workers in animal care practices and support quality assurance and continuous improvement of farm operations.

skills.text: Attention to detail to ensure accurate data recording, sample collection, and compliance with quality and safety standards.
Basic record-keeping and reporting skills to maintain accurate production and health documentation.
Effective communication skills to liaise with farm staff, veterinarians, and team members.
Problem-solving abilities to address health issues, equipment malfunctions, or production challenges.
Strong observational skills to detect signs of illness, distress, or stress in animals.
Competency in designing and implementing animal health, welfare, and productivity improvement programmes.
Competency in interpreting laboratory results to support herd and flock productivity improvement.

Proficiency in farm management systems and agricultural data management software for monitoring production performance.
Proficiency in laboratory testing and diagnostic analysis for livestock and poultry health samples.
Proficiency in operating and maintaining farm machinery, milking equipment, and poultry production tools.

roles.title: Halal Livestock Production Supervisor
roles.description: Halal Livestock Production Supervisor manages and oversees halal livestock farming operations, ensuring all animals are raised, handled, and processed in compliance with halal standards and Islamic law. The role includes supervising daily farm activities, managing staff, coordinating with slaughterhouses, monitoring animal health, implementing biosecurity measures, and maintaining records for halal certification. Supervisors may focus on specific livestock types, such as ruminants or poultry, while also overseeing resources, budgets, and operational data to ensure efficient and compliant farm management.
tasks: Supervise the care, feeding, and housing of halal livestock in accordance with religious and health standards.
Ensure all livestock farming activities comply with halal certification requirements and government regulations.
Monitor animal health, implement disease prevention measures, and maintain biosecurity protocols.
Coordinate the halal slaughtering process with certified slaughterhouses.
Supervise and train farm workers to ensure compliance with halal procedures and safety standards.
Enforce workplace sanitation and Good Hygiene Practices (GHP) to prevent disease.
Maintain detailed records for halal audits and certification compliance.
Conduct regular inspections of farm operations and report on productivity and compliance.

skills.text: Attention to detail to ensure compliance with halal standards and regulatory requirements.

roles.title: Assistant Agricultural Officer Grade G5
roles.description: Assistant Agricultural Officer Grade G5 responsible for carrying out development duties, including planning, implementing, evaluating, and monitoring development programs through the execution of Projek Perladangan Berkelompok. Enforcing plant quarantine, pest management, farm/premises inspections, and treatment of agricultural materials.

Processing participant registration, inspection, verification of planting materials, and managing data for the Malaysian Good Agricultural Practices Scheme (SALM), Malaysian Organic Scheme (SOM), and Seed Certification Scheme (SPBT).
Preparing information, reports, documents, policy reviews, project planning, and monitoring program effectiveness.

Coordinating training, courses, seminars, industrial training, logistics, and the management of student and staff data at the Agricultural Institute.

roles.title: Assistant Land Planning Officer Grade G5
roles.description: Assistant Land Planning Officer Grade G5 responsible for implementing the plan management work programme, overseeing, supervising, monitoring and evaluating the implementation of programs/activities for garden affairs, covering farm hygiene activities, fertilisation, plant pest control and rubber and oil palm plantation production, planning, implementing and monitoring the implementation of administrative and development activities society.

roles.title: Land Scheme Supervisor Grade G1
roles.description: Land Scheme Supervisor Grade G1 responsible for supervising, monitoring, overseeing, and evaluating the implementation of programmes/activities for garden management, farm hygiene, plowing, crop pest control, and production of rubber and oil palm plantations.

roles.description: Forestry Technician assists in the management, conservation, and sustainable use of forest and tree resources across various environments, including a natural forest, plantation, or urban landscape. They conduct field surveys, monitor tree and forest health, support reforestation and silviculture activities, and help implement a forest management plan while ensuring compliance with environmental regulations, operating and maintaining forestry equipment, collecting and analysing ecological data, and contributing to biodiversity conservation, timber production, and community-based forestry initiatives.
tasks: Conduct detailed forest inventories and surveys to assess forest conditions, timber volume, and tree health.

Feed and care for larval and juvenile aquatic species daily.
Clean, disinfect, and maintain tanks, incubators, and equipment to ensure hygiene and biosecurity.

The supervisor ensures compliance with relevant health, safety and environmental regulations, maintains production records, and coordinates harvesting and quality control to meet operational and market requirements.

Maintain and monitor water quality parameters, including oxygen levels, temperature, and pH.

Implement and enforce biosecurity, environmental, and workplace safety measures.

Planning, coordinating, and implementing enforcement of the Fisheries Act, joint operations, intelligence activities, and management of intrusion complaints.

Supporting project planning, development reports, secretariat duties for international meetings, and coordinating international route procedures.

roles.title: Fishery Assistant Grade G1
roles.description: Fishery Assistant Grade G1 responsible to help plan, formulate and coordinate the development of the country's fisheries sector effectively to achieve the department’s overall mission, vision, and objectives. Assist in preparing robust and relevant sectoral and strategic plans to support the development of the county’s fisheries sector. Responsible for assisting in facilitating the implementation of aquaculture development projects to achieve fish production targets through aquaculture activities.
tasks: Supervising, collecting, processing, and analysing data on fish landings, exports/imports, aquaculture, and reports.
Supporting Fisheries Officers in data management, documentation, exhibitions, publicity, and the preparation of departmental reports and publications.
Managing biosecurity, files, correspondence, farm, vessel, and premises registration, and dissemination of up-to-date documents/data.
Assisting in the enforcement of the Fisheries Act, monitoring patrol boats, conducting SAR operations, handling intrusions, disposals, and vessel auctions.
Managing licensing, permits, Sailing Pass Certificates (SPC), sanctuary areas, endangered species, and regulation of fisheries operators.

roles.title: Air Traffic Safety Technician
roles.description: Air Traffic Safety Technician installs, maintains and repairs air traffic control and air navigation systems to ensure the safe and efficient operation of air traffic services. The role involves monitoring, testing and calibrating radar, communication, navigation and surveillance equipment, diagnosing faults and conducting routine inspections to prevent system failures. They support the technical operation and reliability of aviation safety infrastructure in compliance with national and international aviation standards.

Perform preventive maintenance, diagnostics, troubleshooting, and repair of air navigation equipment to ensure operational readiness and minimise downtime.
Assist in the installation, testing, and operation of air navigation systems under technical supervision.

The role involves conducting routine and unscheduled maintenance, diagnosing mechanical and electrical faults, replacing or repairing defective components, and performing system checks in accordance with manufacturer specifications and civil aviation regulations. Aviation Maintenance Technicians maintain accurate maintenance records and work closely with engineers, pilots and relevant authorities to support compliance and the continued operational readiness of aircraft.
tasks: Perform routine inspections and maintenance on aircraft engines, avionics, hydraulic, electrical, and structural systems.

Conduct pre-flight and post-flight checks to ensure aircraft operational readiness and safety system functionality.

roles.description: Aircraft Restorer restores, repairs and refurbishes aircraft to return them to original, historical or airworthy condition. The role involves conducting detailed inspections, diagnosing structural and mechanical defects, and dismantling, restoring and reassembling airframes, systems and components using appropriate modern and traditional techniques. roles.description: Airframe and Power Plant Technician maintains, inspects, repairs and overhauls aircraft structures, engines and associated mechanical, pneumatic and hydraulic systems to ensure continued airworthiness and safe operation. The role includes carrying out scheduled and unscheduled maintenance, diagnosing faults, replacing or repairing defective components, conducting functional tests, and removing and installing engines and major assemblies in accordance with approved technical data and aviation regulations. roles.title: Rocket Engine Component Technician
roles.description: Rocket Engine Component Technician assembles, maintains, inspects, repairs, overhauls and tests rocket engine components and related propulsion systems to ensure compliance with stringent safety, quality and performance standards. roles.title: Berthing Master

The Berthing Master also monitors weather and tide conditions, supervises on-board operations, and ensures adherence to safety protocols to minimise risks and maintain efficient port activities.

roles.title: Train Technician

They plan and design residential, commercial, retail, and hospitality environments, ensuring compliance with safety and building regulations, and often collaborate with architects, contractors, and suppliers to implement the design plan. Their work may also extend to creating visual materials such as posters and other print media to support the overall design concept.

Their work combines strategic planning, creative design, and hands-on execution, often collaborating with marketing and store teams to ensure the display is effective and cohesive across spaces.

roles.description: Child Care Worker provides care and supervision for children in day care centres, preschools, or residential settings, ensuring their safety, health, and well-being. roles.description: Phlebotomist is responsible for collecting blood samples from patients for medical testing, research, or donation. Maintaining and ensuring that equipment is safe, functional, and ready for use.

roles.title: Doorkeeper
roles.description: Doorkeeper is responsible for managing access and ensuring security at the entrances of hotels, restaurants, and residential buildings. They greet and assist visitors, enforce entry protocols to admit only authorised individuals, provide information as needed, and help maintain a safe and orderly environment.
tasks: Monitor building entrances and exits to control access.
Verify identification and visitor credentials before allowing entry.
Maintain visitor registers and report suspicious activities.
Observe for unauthorised persons and alert building management or relevant authorities.
Inform security personnel or law enforcement when required.
Follow established procedures during emergencies and security incidents.
Assist guests and visitors with entry and general enquiries.
Provide directions and basic assistance to visitors within the premises.
Notify tenants of visitor arrivals.
Assist guests or tenants with services such as hailing taxicabs.

skills.text: Active listening skills to understand requests and respond appropriately.

roles.title: Chief Security Guard
roles.description: Chief Security Guard is responsible for overseeing and managing the security team to protect personnel, property, and information. They plan and implement security measures, ensure compliance with safety protocols, handle security incidents, supervise staff performance, conduct training, and coordinate with law enforcement and emergency services as required.

Implement established security procedures to protect people, property, and organisational assets.
Investigate incidents, breaches, or suspicious activities and take appropriate action.
Monitor surveillance, access control, and time-attendance systems.
Ensure security equipment and systems are properly maintained and operational.
Enforce security policies and procedures, and take corrective action for violations.
Train and supervise security personnel.
Prepare and maintain accurate incident, patrol, and activity reports.
Report security issues and updates to management.
Ensure security operations comply with organisational policies and regulatory requirements.

roles.title: Immigration Officer Grade KP1
roles.description: Immigration Officer Grade KP1 responsible for the task of issuing passports and travel documents, issuing visas, passes and permits, regulating the movement of entry points at gazetted entry points as well as providing quality and efficient support services to the customers of the department to further strengthen the management of the organisation as well as to improve the quality of immigration services to meet the aspirations of the people and the country.
tasks: Assisting the Head of Enforcement Unit at the state/branch/district level in supervising and ensuring immigration enforcement operations comply with established standards and procedures.

Assisting the Head of Enforcement Unit at the state/branch/district level in overseeing and conducting inspections to enforce provisions under the Immigration Act 1959/63, Passport Act 1966, and Immigration Regulations 1963.
Conducting inspections and follow-up actions on premises and workers violating immigration laws.
Conducting investigations and prosecutions for immigration offenses and assisting in compounding programmes, blacklisting, and deportation.
Supervising and implementing awareness programmes for citizens and foreigners regarding penalties for breaching immigration laws.
Processing applications related to foreign workers across various sectors.
Processing visa, passport, and entry permit applications, as well as matters related to Malaysia My Second Home (MM2H) and the Asian Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) Business Travel Card.
Monitoring the movement of citizens and visitors, and preparing inbound/outbound statistics for various agencies and government requirements.
Assisting the Head of Enforcement Unit in managing and planning operational schedules and the types of operations to be carried out at all times.
Assisting in supervising programmes aimed at achieving zero Illegal Immigrant (PATI) presence in Malaysia.

skills.text: Ability to communicate effectively both orally and in writing in Bahasa Melayu and English.
Ability to interact well in providing opinions, advisory services, and solving problems.
Ability to write reports effectively.
Computer skills.

roles.title: Assistant Superintendent of Custom Grade WK1 (Departmental Assistant Enforcement Officer/Departmental Assistant Executive Officer)
roles.description: Assistant Superintendent of Custom Grade WK1 (Departmental Assistant Enforcement Officer/Departmental Assistant Executive Officer) collects taxes and provides customs facilitation to the trade and industrial sectors, and enhance regulatory compliance in the interest of the nation’s economic, social, and security objectives.
tasks: Registering customs forms and documents for imports, exports, excise, petroleum, and sales/service taxes.
Inspecting dutiable goods.
Assisting in the collection of duties and taxes.
Processing the release of goods.
Reviewing and processing licensing applications for industries, warehousing, excise, and taxation.
Inspecting passengers and vehicles entering or leaving Malaysia.
Assisting in anti-smuggling enforcement operations, including patrols, roadblocks, raids, and surveillance.
Witnessing the destruction of residual raw materials.

roles.title: Game Warden
roles.description: Game Warden is responsible for protecting and managing wildlife and natural habitats within national parks, wildlife reserves, and other conservation areas. They enforce laws to prevent illegal hunting and poaching, monitor animal populations, maintain the safety of recreational areas, and promote public awareness of environmental conservation.
tasks: Patrol and monitor wildlife areas to prevent illegal activities such as poaching and logging.
Enforce wildlife and environmental protection rules in the field.
Conduct wildlife population surveys and assess habitat conditions.
Monitor public use of protected and recreational areas and report rule violations.
Maintain safety and cleanliness of wildlife reserves and recreational facilities.
Ensure equipment and facilities are safe, functional, and properly maintained.
Respond to, record, and report incidents, offences, and violations promptly.

skills.text: Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team.

First aid and survival skills.

Proficiency in wildlife monitoring and use of GPS and field equipment.

roles.title: Industrial Investigator
roles.description: Industrial Investigator examines and assesses sources of industrial pollution and workplace incidents to ensure compliance with environmental and safety regulations. They conduct investigations, collect evidence, analyse reports, and interview relevant parties to identify causes and prevent recurrence, working closely with management, regulatory authorities, and legal teams to uphold occupational safety and health standards and enhance workplace safety practices.
tasks: Conduct investigations into workplace accidents, incidents, and safety breaches.
Gather and analyse physical, documentary, and other relevant evidence during investigations.
Interview workers, management, and other involved parties to obtain accurate information.
Inspect machinery, equipment, and facilities to assess safety conditions and compliance.
Verify that production processes comply with established standards, procedures, and legal requirements.
Inspect processes and outputs to ensure adherence to safety standards.
Monitor and assess consumer and worker safety practices within industrial settings.
Prepare investigation reports and recommend corrective and preventive safety measures.
Liaise with regulatory authorities during inspections, audits, and compliance activities.

roles.title: Recreation Supervisor
roles.description: Recreation Supervisor plans, organises, and oversees recreational programs in community, public, or private settings, including sports, arts, games, and social activities. They manage staff, maintain facilities and equipment, and ensure safety and compliance, while promoting physical fitness, social interaction, and overall well-being for participants of all ages.
tasks: Develop and implement recreational programmes for different age groups and abilities.
Supervise recreational staff and volunteers.
Plan, schedule and coordinate recreational events and activities.
Ensure the safety, cleanliness and proper use of recreational facilities.
Monitor participant safety and enforce rules and facility guidelines.
Inspect, maintain and ensure the safe condition of recreational equipment.
Coordinate with community groups to promote participation in programmes.

skills.text: Basic computer literacy for scheduling, reporting, and communication tasks.

roles.title: Lifeguard
roles.description: Lifeguard is responsible for ensuring the safety of individuals in aquatic environments such as swimming pools, beaches, and water parks. They monitor water activities to prevent accidents, enforce safety rules, and respond to emergencies by performing rescues and administering first aid or CPR when necessary. They also supervise swimmers, maintain order in designated swimming areas, and educate the public on water safety practices to promote a safe recreational environment.
tasks: Monitor swimmers and aquatic areas continuously to detect distress, unsafe behaviour, or hazards.
Patrol swimming pools, beaches, and designated aquatic zones to prevent accidents.
Perform water rescues, including surface and underwater rescues, when required.
Provide emergency first aid, CPR, and basic life support to injured or distressed individuals.
Enforce facility rules, safety procedures, and regulations to ensure public safety.
Inspect, maintain, and ensure readiness of rescue, diving, and communication equipment.
Provide guidance to the public on water safety and respond to requests for assistance.

roles.title: Traffic Controller
roles.description: Traffic Controller manages and directs the flow of vehicular and pedestrian traffic to ensure safety and maintain efficiency across roads, highways, construction zones, and event areas. They monitor traffic conditions, enforce regulations, respond to accidents or disruptions, and coordinate with enforcement and emergency services to minimise hazards and maintain orderly movement. Their work includes safeguarding pedestrians at crossings, guiding motorists, and supporting smooth traffic operations.
tasks: Maintain traffic safety and orderly flow on roads, highways, and pedestrian areas.
Direct vehicular and pedestrian movement during normal operations, roadworks, emergencies, and public events.
Implement and adjust traffic management measures, including signage, barriers, and temporary controls.
Monitor traffic conditions and identify hazards, incidents, or unsafe road situations.
Assist pedestrians, including children and vulnerable road users, to cross roads safely when required.
Respond to traffic incidents and emergencies as required.

roles.title: Animal Control Warden
roles.description: Animal Control Warden enforces laws and regulations related to the protection, control, and welfare of animals within a community. They respond to reports of stray, abandoned, injured, or dangerous animals, investigate cases of animal cruelty or neglect, and capture or remove animals that pose a risk to public safety. They may coordinate with veterinarians, shelters, and law enforcement, ensure animals are handled humanely, and educate the public on responsible pet ownership and animal welfare regulations.
tasks: Handle and restrain animals during investigations of mistreatment or neglect.
Capture, control, and manage abandoned, dangerous, or unattended animals.
Monitor animals for signs of illness, injury, or distress and take appropriate action.
Maintain clean, safe, and secure housing and living conditions for animals.
Feed and care for animals according to welfare standards.
Support basic animal care procedures.
Provide guidance to the public on responsible animal care and safety practices.

Strong communication skills to interact with colleagues, veterinarians, and the public.

roles.title: Private Detective
roles.description: Private Detective conducts investigations to obtain information for personal, legal, or financial matters. Their work may include surveillance, background checks, locating missing persons, and collecting evidence related to cases such as fraud, theft, insurance claims, or civil disputes. They analyse information, interview individuals, and prepare detailed reports for clients or legal proceedings. They typically work independently or within investigative agencies and must operate within legal and ethical boundaries when gathering and handling information.
tasks: Investigate suspected criminal, fraudulent, or unethical activities involving individuals or organisations.
Conduct surveillance and undercover operations to gather information and evidence discreetly.
Collect, analyse, and document evidence for legal, disciplinary, or administrative proceedings.
Perform background checks on persons or businesses using lawful information sources.
Interview clients, witnesses, and relevant parties to obtain factual information.
Prepare clear and detailed investigative reports in accordance with legal and professional standards.
Use investigative tools and technologies, including databases, recording devices, and tracking equipment, where permitted by law.
Maintain professional liaison with relevant authorities and legal professionals when necessary.
Ensure confidentiality, ethical conduct, and compliance with applicable laws throughout investigations.

roles.title: Social Benefits Assistant
roles.description: Social Benefits Assistant supports the administration of social welfare and assistance programmes by helping individuals access available benefits and services. They assist in reviewing applications and verifying eligibility, process claims and supporting documents, maintain accurate beneficiary records, and liaise with relevant agencies or departments to ensure timely delivery of aid and support for vulnerable groups.

Enter, update, and maintain beneficiary and programme data in computerised information systems.
Explain social welfare procedures, regulations, and relevant legislation to applicants.
Respond to public enquiries regarding eligibility criteria, benefit entitlements, and payment processes.
Provide information to individuals on government social benefit programmes.
Conduct outreach activities to inform communities about available social assistance and benefits.
Prepare routine reports and summaries for supervisors and relevant government authorities.
Coordinate with other social service providers to support individuals and households in need.

roles.title: Licensing Assistant
roles.description: Licensing Assistant supports the administration of licensing and permit processes by receiving and reviewing applications, verifying supporting documents, and ensuring submissions comply with relevant laws, regulations, and procedural requirements. They coordinate with regulatory authorities and internal stakeholders to facilitate application processing, identify applicable conditions or documentation requirements, and assist in monitoring compliance. They also maintain accurate records and prepare documentation and reports to support efficient licensing operations.

Verify applicant information and supporting documentation against regulatory requirements.
Prepare and issue licences to applicants who meet prescribed standards and conditions.
Collect, record, and process licence fees and related payments.

Update and maintain accurate licensing records in databases and filing systems.
Monitor licence validity, including renewals, expiries, and compliance deadlines.
Advise applicants and licence holders on licensing, permit, and regulatory requirements.
Respond to public and stakeholder enquiries regarding licence applications and status.
Notify licence holders of non-compliance, infractions, or applicable penalties.
