roles.title: Maritime Enforcement Officer of Other Ranks Grade T1
roles.description: Maritime Enforcement Officer of Other Ranks Grade T1 responsible for carrying out support-level duties involving the Malaysian Maritime Zone in terms of enforcing laws and regulations under federal law, perform search and rescue tasks, prevent and restrict the commission of offenses, provide assistance in matters related to criminalisation when applied by a foreign country, perform air and coastal surveillance and provide transportation services to agencies in need. Additionally, the task carried out in the Malaysian Maritime Zone and the high seas is to search and rescue, control and prevention of maritime pollution, prevention and blocking of swarming as well as prevention and blocking of narcotic drug trafficking. Duties performed shall be placed under the general command and control of the Malaysian Armed Forces during an emergency, special crisis, or war.
tasks: Enforcing laws and maintains public order under Federal law within Malaysia’s Maritime Zone.
Implementing policies related to navigation and security in Malaysia’s Maritime Zone.
Managing logistics and operational activities efficiently.

Conducting maritime search and rescue, coastal and aerial surveillance, pollution control, prevention and interception of illegal entry, and prevention and interdiction of illicit narcotics distribution.
Executing instructions to assist in criminal matters requested by foreign countries as provided under the Mutual Assistance in Criminal Matters Act 2002 (Act 621).
Assisting in gathering security intelligence and recommending measures to improve operational effectiveness.
Conducting maritime and aerial patrols and operations within Malaysia’s Maritime Zone efficiently and effectively.
Planning, conducting, and enhancing the quality of personnel training, operational training, and joint exercises in national maritime areas.
Facilitating coordination and collaboration with other departments/agencies regarding law enforcement in Malaysia’s Maritime Zone.

skills.text: Competency in marine science, shipping, and information and communication technology.
Knowledge and skills in federal laws within the National Maritime Zone as well as international maritime laws.

roles.title: Enforcement Assistant Grade KP1
roles.description: Enforcement Assistant Grade KP1 responsible for enforcing the Road Transport Act 1987 (Act 333), the Commercial Vehicles Licensing Board Act 1987 (Act 334), and the Road Transport Rules, managing, monitoring, and reviewing all operational enforcement, prosecution, and investigation activities efficiently and effectively, as well as providing advisory services to meet the needs and expectations of stakeholders.

Performing duties in the control room.
Receiving complaints and information from the public.
Acting as a witness in court cases.
Carrying out duties at the Enforcement Counter.

skills.text: Competency in marine science, shipping, and information and communication technology.
Knowledge and skills in federal laws within the National Maritime Zone as well as international maritime laws.

roles.title: Registration Assistant Grade KP1
roles.description: Registration Assistant Grade KP1 responsible for implementing activities and core transactions at the division/state/district/branch level by ensuring that divisional operations achieve the prescribed standards and procedures based on the Births and Deaths Registration Act 1957 (Act 299), Registration of Births and Deaths Ordinance 1951 (Sabah Cap. 123), Registration of Births and Deaths Ordinance 1951 (Sarawak Cap. 123), Registration of Birth and Deaths (Special Provision) Act 1975 (Act 1952), Registration of Adoptions Act 1952 (Act 253), Adoption Ordinance 1941 (Sarawak Cap. 91), National Registration Act 1959 (Act 78) and National Registration Regulations 1990 (Amendment 2001), the Federal Constitution, Part III (Citizenship), and the Law Reform (Marriage and Divorce) Act 1976 (Act 164).
tasks: Receiving and processing applications for MyKad, birth registration, death registration, adoption, marriage, divorce, and citizenship.
Ensuring all documents are completed accurately and organised systematically.
Providing explanations and responsing to complaints from customers, the Public Complaints Bureau, and other government agencies.
Collecting and maintaining monthly and annual reports for all transactions at JPN/ District offices.
Issuing official documents such as MyKad, letters, MyKid, birth certificates, death certificates, identity cards, and letters for Bahasa Melayu examinations.
Managing financial transactions and revenue collection reporting.
Handling requests for birth and death extracts and searches, including standard and late registrations at the counter.
Receiving and processing cases reported by all government agencies and the public.
Receiving, verifying, and maintaining records from various divisions and branches for permanent storage.

skills.text: Ability to communicate effectively both verbally and in writing in Bahasa Melayu.
Computer skills.

roles.title: Field Crop Farm Worker
roles.description: Field Crop Farm Worker plans and carries out the cultivation and harvesting of field and plantation crops, including cereals, vegetables, fruits and fibre crops, for sale or distribution to markets and buyers. The role involves land preparation, planting or sowing, irrigation, fertilisation, pest and disease control, harvesting and post-harvest handling, as well as operating and maintaining farm machinery and equipment. They monitor crop growth and apply appropriate farming practices to ensure sustainable production, optimal yield and quality of output.
tasks: Prepare and maintain farmland, fields, orchards or plantations, including soil preparation, land management and soil health maintenance.
Plant, sow, transplant and cultivate field, fruit, fibre and tropical crops according to production requirements.
Manage irrigation, drainage and fertilisation to support optimal crop growth.
Monitor crop growth, soil conditions, pests and diseases, and apply appropriate control measures when necessary.
Harvest crops at the appropriate maturity stage and carry out basic post-harvest handling, processing and storage.
Operate, maintain and perform routine servicing of farm machinery, tools and equipment used in crop production.
Apply fertilisers, pesticides, herbicides and other agricultural inputs in accordance with safety and environmental guidelines.

roles.title: Inspector Quality (Plantation)

Assist in implementing corrective actions to address quality non-conformities.

roles.title: Grader (Oil Palm)
roles.description: Grader (Oil Palm) inspects and assesses Fresh Fruit Bunches (FFB) to determine their maturity, size and overall quality in accordance with established industry standards. The role ensures that only suitable fruit is accepted for processing by identifying defects and non-compliant produce, thereby supporting operational efficiency and product quality in palm oil production. Graders also maintain accurate grading records and document harvest source information for traceability and reporting purposes.
tasks: Inspect fresh fruit bunches (FFB) for maturity, size, colour, and defects, and sort and grade them according to established grading standards and inspection results.
Remove damaged fruits and foreign objects from the processing line as part of quality control procedures.
Record grading results accurately and maintain required documentation and reports.
Operate grading-related machinery and equipment safely in accordance with operational procedures.
Assist mill operators in coordinating activities to support efficient and timely palm oil processing.
Maintain cleanliness, hygiene, and safety in the grading area in compliance with workplace standards.
Report quality issues, discrepancies, and operational problems to supervisors in a timely manner.
Follow established grading standards, procedures, and relevant regulations in all grading activities.

skills.text: Ability to work as part of a team with mill operators and supervisors.
Attention to detail to accurately grade and sort fresh fruit bunches (FFB).
Basic record-keeping skills to record grading results and maintain simple reports.
Clear communication skills to report grading results and discrepancies.
Physical stamina to work long hours in the field and handle heavy fruit loads.
Ability to monitor and maintain grading equipment for optimal performance.
Knowledge in fresh fruit bunch (FFB) grading standards and quality control procedures.
Knowledge in palm oil milling processes and workflow coordination.
Proficiency in basic mechanical maintenance and repair of grading machinery.
Proficiency in operating grading machinery and related equipment.

roles.title: Supervisor (Plantation)
roles.description: Supervisor (Plantation) supervises and coordinates daily field operations in plantation estates, including crop cultivation, harvesting, nursery management, and general field maintenance. The role involves directing and allocating workers, planning and monitoring activities such as planting, manuring, weeding, and pruning, and ensuring work is carried out in accordance with operational, safety, and environmental standards. The supervisor also maintains records of field activities, monitors crop and seedling conditions, and reports progress to estate management to support productivity and efficient plantation management.

Assign tasks, guide plantation workers and outsourced labour, and ensure work is carried out safely and effectively.
Monitor crop health, yield, and quality, and oversee pest control and routine agronomic activities.
Ensure correct harvesting techniques and crop ripeness in accordance with plantation standards.
Oversee the proper application of fertilisers, including rates, methods, and coverage.
Ensure compliance with occupational safety, health, and environmental requirements and promote safe work practices.
Maintain plantation cleanliness, including weed control, waste management, and general field upkeep.

roles.title: Crop Farmer
roles.description: Crop Farmer cultivates and manages crops such as vegetables, fruits, grains, or other agricultural produce for commercial sale. The role involves planning and carrying out farming operations including land preparation, planting, irrigation, pest and disease control, crop maintenance, harvesting, and basic post-harvest handling to ensure quality and yield. Crop farmers organise production activities and supply produce to wholesale buyers, marketing organisations, processors, or local markets.
tasks: Prepare and maintain farmland, including soil preparation and land management activities.
Plant crops such as vegetables, shrubs, and trees according to established plans and suitable conditions.
Carry out crop cultivation activities including sowing, planting, pruning, and tending to crops.
Manage irrigation and fertilisation to support healthy crop growth.
Monitor crops for pests, diseases, and plant health issues, and apply appropriate control measures.
Harvest crops and prepare produce for storage, sale, or distribution.
Operate and maintain farm machinery, equipment, nurseries, and greenhouses as required.
Handle and use seeds, fertilisers, and other agricultural inputs appropriately.
Keep records of farm activities, crop growth, and yields.
Follow environmental, safety, and agricultural regulations and standards.

Proficiency in operating and maintaining farm machinery and equipment.
Proficiency in pest and disease identification and management for crops.
Proficiency in pruning, shaping, and horticultural practices.

roles.title: Gardener/Horticultural Worker
roles.description: Gardener/Horticultural Worker maintains and cultivates trees, shrubs, flowers and other plants in residential, commercial and public settings, including parks and landscaped areas. The role involves planting, pruning, watering, fertilising and controlling pests to ensure plant health and aesthetic standards, and may include shaping and specialised care of ornamental plants such as bonsai. They may also propagate and grow saplings, bulbs and seeds for sale or distribution, and undertake basic landscape establishment and upkeep.
tasks: Plant, transplant, and cultivate flowers, shrubs, trees, and other plants in gardens, parks, or landscaped areas.
Prepare soil, sow seeds, and propagate plants to produce planting materials such as saplings and bulbs.
Prune, trim, shape, and maintain plants to support healthy growth and appearance.
Water, fertilise, and manage soil and irrigation conditions to support healthy plant growth.
Monitor plant health and implement pest and disease control measures.
Maintain lawns and landscaped areas to ensure aesthetic quality and plant health.
Maintain garden tools, equipment, and work areas in safe and serviceable condition.
Manage garden waste and debris and perform general garden maintenance activities.

Proficiency in basic irrigation systems operation and maintenance.
Proficiency in pruning, trimming, and general plant maintenance techniques.

roles.title: Mixed Crop Farmer
roles.description: Mixed Crop Farmer cultivates a variety of crops, including vegetables, fruits and other plants, on the same area of land for commercial sale. The role involves planning and carrying out land preparation, planting, irrigation, crop maintenance, pest and disease control, harvesting, and post-harvest handling, while applying crop rotation and other sustainable practices to maintain soil health and optimise production.
tasks: Plant, sow, cultivate, and tend mixed crops according to crop plans and established agricultural practices.
Manage irrigation and fertilisation to support healthy crop growth.
Monitor crop conditions and implement pest and disease control measures.
Harvest crops and perform basic post-harvest handling and processing activities.
Operate and perform basic maintenance of farm machinery and equipment.
Maintain records of farm activities and crop yields.

roles.title: Livestock Breeder
roles.description: Livestock Breeder breeds and rears animals and other commercially or agriculturally important species, including livestock, bees and selected reptiles or invertebrates, for the production of food, fibre, by-products or for conservation and research purposes. The role involves selecting breeding stock, managing reproduction and growth cycles, maintaining appropriate housing and environmental conditions, and safeguarding animal health, hygiene and biosecurity. Breeders monitor production outputs, maintain relevant records, and ensure compliance with animal welfare, agricultural and wildlife regulations.
tasks: Select and manage breeding stock based on observable traits and production requirements.
Carry out mating, breeding, and reproduction activities according to established schedules and practices.
Breed, raise, feed, and care for livestock and other farmed animals or insects.
Monitor animal or insect health, welfare, growth, and offspring development, and apply disease control measures.
Provide appropriate nutrition and manage feeding practices according to species requirements.
Maintain and manage housing, enclosures, hives, ponds, beds, or other breeding facilities.
Harvest, handle, and carry out basic processing of animal or insect products such as young stock, honey, and cocoons.
Maintain records of breeding, health, production, and stock numbers.
Follow biosecurity, safety, and environmental regulations and standards in farm operations.

roles.title: Mixed Animal Husbandry Farm Worker
roles.description: Mixed Animal Husbandry Farm Worker is responsible for the care and management of various livestock species, including cattle, poultry, and small ruminants. They perform routine tasks such as feeding, breeding, health monitoring, and general husbandry, and may assist in farm management while ensuring adherence to agricultural standards and practices.

Monitor animal health, provide basic treatments, and report health conditions as required.
Assist with breeding, calving, and other livestock reproduction activities.
Maintain cleanliness and hygiene of animal housing, including stables and hatcheries.
Clean udders and operate milking equipment in accordance with hygiene standards.
Operate and perform routine maintenance of farm tools and equipment.
Maintain records of livestock health, production, and farm activities.
Inspect and patrol livestock areas to ensure animal welfare and safety.

roles.title: Dairy Producer
roles.description: Dairy Producer oversees the production of milk and other dairy products, managing farm operations and ensuring the health and welfare of livestock. They supervise milking and processing activities, maintain equipment, and ensure products meet food safety and quality standards, while also handling breeding and care of animals to supply milk, cheese, and yoghurt for commercial distribution.

Care for dairy livestock by feeding, watering, and maintaining animal welfare.
Assist with breeding and herd management activities according to established practices.
Maintain farm buildings, machinery, and facilities in clean and serviceable condition.
Follow food safety, hygiene, and quality standards in dairy farm operations.
Maintain records of milk production, livestock, and farm inventory.

roles.title: Poultry Breeder
roles.description: Poultry Breeder plans and manages the breeding and raising of poultry to produce high-quality hatching eggs, meat, or other products. The role involves monitoring flock health, fertility, and hatchability, ensuring proper feeding and environmental conditions, implementing biosecurity measures, maintaining records, and overseeing daily farm operations to meet production and regulatory standards.
tasks: Feed poultry and manage water, lighting, and housing conditions to support flock health.
Monitor flock health and performance, and inspect poultry for signs of illness, injury, or infection.
Administer medications and vaccinations, and remove weak or dead birds as required.
Collect, grade, and store eggs, including hatching eggs, for production or sale.
Apply biosecurity, hygiene, and animal welfare practices in poultry operations.
Maintain records of poultry production, breeding activities, and farm operations.

roles.title: Operator (Incubator - Poultry Farm)
roles.description: Operator (Incubator - Poultry Farm) manages the production of poultry eggs, overseeing incubation and hatching processes. This includes setting up and monitoring incubators, maintaining optimal conditions for egg development, transferring eggs to hatchers, and caring for hatchlings. The role also ensures proper maintenance and cleanliness of equipment and facilities to support efficient operations.

Monitor and adjust temperature and humidity to maintain optimal incubation conditions.
Collect, inspect, and place eggs into incubators following established procedures.
Transfer eggs to hatchers at the appropriate stages of incubation.
Care for and handle newly hatched chicks in accordance with welfare practices.
Operate machinery for egg washing, grading, and packing.
Handle, store, and transport eggs properly to prevent damage.
Clean and perform routine maintenance of hatchery equipment and facilities.
Maintain records of incubation, hatching, and production data.

roles.title: Sexer (Poultry)
roles.description: Sexer (Poultry) determines the sex of newly hatched chicks to support efficient poultry production. This role involves accurately and quickly identifying male and female chicks, which are then managed differently according to their purpose, such as egg or meat production, ensuring optimal farm operations and productivity.

roles.title: Animal Vaccinator
roles.description: Animal Vaccinator is responsible for preventing and controlling diseases in animals by administering vaccines according to veterinary protocols. They prepare and handle vaccines, maintain accurate vaccination records, and monitor animals for any adverse reactions. This role supports overall animal health and biosecurity, often under the supervision of veterinarians.

Monitor animals for adverse reactions following vaccination and report any abnormalities.
Maintain records of vaccinations, treatments, and animal health information.
Store and handle vaccines and medications according to cold chain and safety requirements.
Administer basic medications within authorised scope and refer cases to veterinarians when required.
Assist veterinarians during vaccination programmes and animal health procedures.
Maintain cleanliness, hygiene, and biosecurity standards at vaccination sites.

roles.title: Worker (Incubator)
roles.description: Worker (Incubator) is responsible for managing the incubation of poultry eggs, ensuring optimal conditions for hatching by monitoring temperature, humidity, and ventilation, and handling eggs and newly hatched chicks. They operate and maintain hatchery equipment, transfer chicks to brooding areas, and uphold hygiene and biosecurity standards within the hatchery. The role is typically based on livestock farms or agricultural establishments.

Adjust and control temperature, humidity, and ventilation to meet incubation requirements.
Turn eggs at specified intervals during incubation.
Transfer hatched chicks from incubators to designated brooding areas.
Clean, sanitise, and maintain incubators, hatchery equipment, and facilities.
Maintain records of incubation cycles, hatch rates, and related data.

roles.title: Reptile Breeder
roles.description: Reptile Breeder specialises in the selective breeding and care of reptiles and amphibians. The role involves managing breeding programs, maintaining suitable environmental conditions, monitoring animal health and development, and keeping detailed records of lineage, offspring, and breeding cycles. It may also require knowledge of breeding techniques such as artificial insemination and the operation of specialised equipment.
tasks: Oversee and implement reptile breeding programmes, including determining species selection and breeding quantities.
Breed, raise, feed, and care for reptiles in captivity as part of routine husbandry practices.

Set up, operate, and maintain reptile enclosures, sheltered spaces, and specialised equipment.
Maintain compliance with animal welfare, safety, and relevant animal care standards.

roles.title: Sea Snail Breeder
roles.description: Sea Snail Breeder cultivates and propagates sea snails by managing hatcheries, monitoring water quality, and providing appropriate feeding to ensure healthy growth. The role involves selecting and breeding snails based on genealogy and characteristics, maintaining records of breeding cycles and pedigree, and may include applying artificial insemination techniques and monitoring genetic diversity.

Breed, raise, feed, and care for sea snails while implementing feeding schedules and monitoring their growth and health conditions.
Maintain hatchery facilities and equipment, and monitor and control water quality and environmental conditions.
Harvest and process sea snails for commercial or research purposes.
Conduct observations and evaluate breeding cycles, reproductive performance, and stock quality.

roles.title: Farmer (Mixed Farming)
roles.description: Farmer (Mixed Farming) is responsible for managing a farm that integrates both crop cultivation and livestock rearing. The role involves planning and performing land preparation, planting, irrigation, pest control, animal husbandry, harvesting, and post-harvest handling, while ensuring sustainable farming practices. It encompasses the overall operation of the farm to produce crops and livestock for sale or supply to markets and buyers.
tasks: Prepare, maintain, and manage farmland for mixed farming operations including land and resource management.
Plant, cultivate, and harvest crops while raising, feeding, and caring for livestock.
Manage irrigation, fertilisation, and soil conditions to support crop and pasture productivity.
Monitor crop and livestock health, and apply pest, weed, and disease control measures using approved methods.
Operate and maintain farm machinery, tools, and equipment.
Plan farm production, determine crop and livestock types and quantities, and procure necessary farm inputs such as seeds, fertilisers, feed, and supplies.
Maintain farm records, including production outputs, yields, and financial accounts.

roles.title: Forestry Worker
roles.description: Forestry Worker is responsible for managing, conserving, and utilising forest resources. They establish and tend forest areas, fell and trim trees, grade and inspect logs, operate machinery for harvesting and handling timber, and construct log rafts for transport. They also supervise logging operations, enforce forest regulations, conduct surveys, and may train others in forestry techniques, ensuring that forest products are safely and efficiently prepared for sale or delivery.
tasks: Establish, tend, and manage forest areas for logging and regeneration activities.
Identify, select, and mark trees for felling, and estimate timber volume.
Fell, trim, top, and cut trees into logs using appropriate tools and machinery.
Operate and maintain logging, harvesting, yarding, and material-handling equipment.
Transport, load, unload, and organise logs at felling sites, landings, or log yards.
Inspect, measure, grade, and mark logs according to quality, size, and industry standards.
Shape rough wooden products and perform basic processing at the felling site where required.
Coordinate with crew members, signal operators, and supervisors to ensure safe and efficient operations.
Ensure compliance with safety procedures, environmental regulations, and forestry standards.
Maintain equipment, work areas, and records, and report hazards or operational issues.

roles.title: Charcoal Burner
roles.description: Charcoal Burner produces charcoal by carbonizing wood using kilns or arranged piles. The role involves managing the carbonization process, maintaining controlled temperatures, operating kilns safely, and ensuring the proper transformation of wood into charcoal while following safety procedures.

roles.title: Forest Ranger
roles.description: Forest Ranger protects and monitors forested areas to support conservation and sustainable forest management. Duties include patrolling forests to prevent illegal activities such as illegal logging and poaching, monitoring wildlife and forest conditions, enforcing environmental and forestry regulations, and assisting with data collection and conservation programs. Forest rangers may also support forest management activities and work with government agencies and conservation organisations.
tasks: Patrol forest areas to prevent illegal activities and ensure site security.
Monitor forest conditions, including wildlife populations and ecosystem health.
Enforce forestry and environmental laws, regulations, and protection measures.
Conduct field observations, surveys, and basic research on forest ecosystems.
Record, report, and document incidents, findings, and routine observations.
Assist in the management, implementation, and monitoring of forest reserves and protected areas.
Support forest development, harvesting operations, and wood-based industry activities in compliance with regulations.
Collaborate with government agencies, local authorities, and non-governmental organisations on conservation initiatives.
Provide public education and outreach on forest conservation and sustainable practices.

roles.title: Forest Guard Grade G1, G2, G3, G4
roles.description: Forest Guard Grade G1, G2, G3, G4: state Forestry Department - Responsible for carrying out work in implementing all forest development activities, forest harvesting, wood-based industries, forest produce extraction, recreational forests, nurseries, and law enforcement in accordance with the National Forestry Act. Sarawak State Forestry Department - Responsible as the head and officer-in-charge for supervising and monitoring forestry activities to ensure alignment with government regulations, directions, and policies by carrying out administrative and management duties in the field and within forest areas for forest development works, forest management, forest operations, forest research, timber industries, forest plantations, gazettement of forest areas in the field, including enforcement duties under the Forest Ordinance, National Parks Ordinance, and Wildlife Ordinance. The scope and functions of Forest Rangers in the Sarawak Forest Department are subject to the diversity of functions of the units and divisions to which they are assigned. There are 10 divisions and four regional forest offices in the Sarawak Forest Department.
tasks: Supervising and protecting forest areas within the boundaries of forest reserves (Permanent Reserved Forests and State Land Forests).
Conducting law enforcement activities and exercising authority under the National Forestry Act, including detaining, arresting, and seizing offenders.

Carrying out field operations for forest management, forest operations, forest research, timber industry, forest plantations, gazetting of forest areas, and enforcement under the Forest Ordinance, National Parks Ordinance, and Wildlife Ordinance.
Performing measurements and tax assessments for forest product extraction at Forest Inspection Halls (Inland and Mangrove Forests).
Monitoring harvesting activities in all licensed areas to ensure compliance with MS ISO 9001:2008 guidelines and MC&I certification.
Conducting patrols of Permanent Reserved Forests and State Land Forests to prevent encroachment and illegal logging.
Ensuring field work procedures are followed and enforced by logging companies and forestry agencies.
Collecting and recording field data for work planning and preparing monthly and annual progress reports.
Performing all activities within the Forestry Enforcement Unit, including license verification, public complaint investigations, patrols, raids, arrests, and coordinated operations.
Acting as an investigative officer for enforcement under the Forest Ordinance, National Parks Ordinance, and Wildlife Ordinance.

skills.text: Knowledge of environmental conservation.

roles.title: Forest Ranger Grade G1
roles.description: Forest Ranger Grade G1 responsible for assisting District/State Forest Officers in carrying out duties related to forestry activities based on systematic forest management principles in line with government regulations and policies.
tasks: Assisting in carrying out administrative tasks and instructions at the District or State Forest Office.
Assisting the District Forest Officer in tasks related to the gazettement of forest reserve areas, including Permanent Reserved Forests and State Land Forests.

Assisting the District Forest Officer in monitoring and supervising forest reserve areas, forest development activities, forest harvesting, timber-based industry development, forest product extraction, recreational forest management, nursery operations, and the preparation of relevant forestry information.

Enforcing forestry laws, including the National Forestry Act 1984/Sabah - Forest Enactment 1968, Forest Rules 1969/Sarawak - Forest Ordinance 1958, National Parks and Nature Reserves Ordinance 1998, and Wildlife Protection Ordinance 1998.
Ensuring full compliance with the criteria and indicators for forest management certification in Malaysia.
Assisting in tasks related to the management of national parks, nature reserves, and wildlife in the Sarawak Forest Department.
Officers may be assigned to government forestry training centers as an instructor or assistant instructor for forestry courses.

roles.title: Algae Cultivator
roles.description: Algae Cultivator plans, manages, and carries out the breeding and cultivation of algae for commercial purposes. They oversee cultivation systems, monitor environmental conditions, harvest and process algae, and ensure quality for sale or delivery.

The role involves measuring and cutting glass to specification, removing damaged panels, fitting and securing replacement glass, and ensuring proper sealing, insulation and structural integrity in accordance with relevant standards. Glaziers work on residential, commercial and automotive applications to ensure safety, functionality and durability of glass installations.

Measure, mark, and cut glass to the required size and shape for installation.

Install or replace windscreens and other glass components in vehicles or boats.
Remove damaged or broken glass and prepare surfaces for replacement.
Secure glass using clips, putty, sealants, or other fastening systems to ensure proper sealing and stability.
Operate lifting or handling equipment to transport and position large glass panels safely.
Calibrate or reconnect sensors and integrated features in vehicle glass where required.
Maintain tools and equipment and adhere to safety standards and manufacturer guidelines.

The role involves interpreting building plans, installing and connecting pipes, fittings and fixtures, diagnosing faults, and carrying out repairs and replacements in accordance with relevant building codes and safety standards.

roles.title: Pipe Fitter

They interpret technical drawings, measure, cut, bend, join and secure pipes and fittings, and carry out testing to ensure systems are leak-free and compliant with safety and environmental standards. The role may involve work on heating, cooling, ventilation, high- and low-pressure systems, and related mechanical installations.

tasksOnly.title: Legislator
tasksOnly.description: Legislator refers to a group of political leaders responsible for lawmaking, policy formulation, and governance at both federal and state levels. They are tasked with ensuring that government policies are effectively planned, implemented, and evaluated, while representing the interests of the public in legislative and administrative processes. Their role also includes overseeing parliamentary proceedings, ensuring compliance with the constitution, and maintaining the smooth functioning of the system of governance for the well-being of the nation and its people.

Formulate, determine, and direct public policies and government strategies.

Facilitate debates, decision-making processes, and the smooth functioning of legislative bodies.

tasksOnly.title: Senior Government Officials
tasksOnly.description: Senior Government Officials refer to high-level public sector leaders responsible for overseeing national and state administration, providing strategic advice, and ensuring the effective implementation of government policies, laws, and programmes. They play key roles in managing public institutions, safeguarding financial and legal accountability, maintaining national security and public order, delivering essential public services, and representing the government in diplomatic and international relations. Their responsibilities also include coordinating across agencies, advising political leadership, and ensuring that governance is carried out efficiently, transparently, and in accordance with established laws and constitutional provisions to support national development and public well-being.
tasks: Plan, formulate and implement government policies, strategies and programmes at federal and state levels.
Provide strategic advice to the government on policy, legal, financial, economic and administrative matters.
Coordinate, direct and monitor the implementation of policies and activities across departments, agencies and statutory bodies.
Manage public sector administration, including planning, control and evaluation of organisational performance.
Ensure accountability, transparency and integrity in public financial management through auditing and regulatory oversight.
Develop and manage fiscal, financial and accounting policies, including the preparation and monitoring of government budgets.
Safeguard national security and public order, including law enforcement and national defence.
Deliver and ensure the effectiveness of public services, including health, safety and public welfare.
Represent the government in diplomatic relations, international negotiations, and protect national interests and citizens abroad.
Collect, analyse and disseminate information and data to support national planning and policy formulation.

tasksOnly.description: Meteorological Officer Grade C9 issuing weather forecasts, weather warnings, monitoring and issuing information about earthquakes and tsunamis so that property damage and deaths can be reduced, analysing weather changes professionally and identifying impacts and measures to reduce the impacts, analysing meteorological charts and conducting research on weather phenomena to reduce the impact of bad weather. Providing advisory services efficiently and effectively to meet customer needs and expectations of interested parties (stakeholders) to increase socio-economic activities for the people and country
tasks: Issuing public, special, and severe weather forecasts/warnings, and provides briefings to the Disaster Committee and the media.

tasksOnly.title: Industrial Court President
tasksOnly.description: Industrial Court President preside over criminal and civil proceedings in the courts of law.
tasks: Hearing and arbitrating arguments and evidence.
Interpreting and enforcing regulatory procedure and making rulings on the admissibility of evidence.
Directing the jury on the legal details applicable to the case.
Researching a legal issue and preparing a report on the issues.
Improving understanding and coordinating work execution.
Performing related tasks.

tasksOnly.title: Parliamentary Secretary
tasksOnly.description: Parliamentary Secretary assist the ministers in select areas of their ministries but are not members of the cabinet. They answer questions and present reports on behalf of ministers when the minister unable to be present in the parliament.
tasks: Assisting the ministers in select areas of their ministries but are not members of the cabinet. they answer questions and present reports on behalf of ministers when the minister unable to be present in the parliament.
Improving understanding and coordinating work execution.
Performing related tasks.

tasksOnly.title: Penologist
tasksOnly.description: Penologist specialize in prisoner rehabilitation and correctional facility management. As a result, they typically work all day with prison inmates. Penologists work closely with prison guards to prevent prison fights, drug dealing, violence, escape attempts, and antisocial behavior. Penologists are employed at municipal, state, and federal prisons in low and maximum security settings.
tasks: Developing rehabilitation programs and work closely with prison inmates to reduce recidivism rates and teach inmates how to live productively.
Teaching inmates personal responsibility, effective stress and anger management strategies, and substance abuse prevention methods.
Inspecting facilities and checking prison cells for contraband.
Improving understanding and coordinating work execution.
Performing related tasks.

tasksOnly.title: Criminologist
tasksOnly.description: Criminologist examining a range of crimes, conducting extensive research on the social, biological and environmental factors that lead to deviant behavior, identifying criminal patterns, formulating criminal profiles, compiling research reports, and collaborating with law enforcement.
tasks: Gathering and analyzing data about the causes and nature of crime to determine criminal patterns and common traits among criminals.
Researching and analyzing the biological, social, and psychological background of criminals to gain an understanding of the motivation behind their deviant behavior.
Developing profiles of criminal types to assist law enforcement to identify potential criminals, understand their behavior, and apprehend them more efficiently.
Examining crime scenes, evidence, and autopsies to determine what happened and which profile category the criminal falls into.
Improving understanding and coordinating work execution.
Performing related tasks.

tasksOnly.title: Custom and Excise Officer
tasksOnly.description: Custom and Excise Officer inspect people and ships, airplanes and motor vehicles entering and leaving the country to ensure that the correct duties are being paid, illegal goods such as drugs, fauna and flora are not being smuggled and that the necessary documentation is in order.
tasks: Controlling all imports and exports and ensure that the correct import duties are paid.
Inspecting books and documents of importers and exporters to ensure that legislation is complied with and examine goods to determine their composition.
Ensuring that excise duties are levied from firms licensed to manufacture taxable goods such as cigarettes, alcoholic drinks and petrol.
Carrying out inspections on board ships and aircraft entering the country, or inspect the premises of large manufacturers of goods for export to ensure that the correct excise duties are being paid.
Inspecting cargo, baggage and personal belongings entering or leaving the country.
Investigating duty refund applications and appeals for relief or reduction of penalties if necessary.

tasksOnly.title: Government Taxation and Excise Officer
tasksOnly.description: Government Taxation and Excise Officer ensure that taxes and duties are paid on a wide range of goods and services, including alcohol, tobacco, and gaming and betting activities.
tasks: Providing advice on taxation matters to corporations, partnerships, organisations and individuals.
Giving expert advice on laws and regulations pertaining to determination and payment of taxes, duties and other government charges to organisations, industries and individuals.
Examining tax returns, bills of sale and other relevant documents to determine the type and amount of taxes, and employment as well as other types of fees to be paid.
Investigating tax filing statements and accounting records, organisational systems and internal controls to ensure compliance with tax laws and regulations.
Ensuring that duties are paid and attempt to control smuggling.
Improving understanding and coordinating work execution.
Performing related tasks.

tasksOnly.title: Government Licensing Officer
tasksOnly.description: Government Licensing Officer examine applications for licences to export or import goods, set up businesses, build houses or other structures, or to determine eligibility of applications for issuing licences or passports, and identify specific conditions or restrictions to be attached to licences issued, refer exceptional or important cases to senior government officials or managers.
tasks: Interpreting and explaining related procedures, regulations and laws.
Advising individuals about the law and government regulations on the types of licences required and the conditions attached to the licences, and on the rights and obligations of the public.
Examining applications and related documents and determining whether the licences should be granted and the conditions to be attached.
Examining applications and approving the issue of passports.
Carrying out administrative tasks related to process applications, document activities, evaluations and determinations, and to prepare correspondence to inform applicants of licensing decisions.
Administering and conducting tests required of license applicants.
Enforcing procedures, rules and laws.

tasksOnly.title: Senior Police Officer
tasksOnly.description: Senior Police Officer carrying out police duties in line with the functions of the Management Department of the Criminal Investigation Department, Department of Internal Security and Public Order, Logistics Department, Narcotics Criminal Investigation Department, Special Branch and Commercial Crime Investigation Department.
tasks: Administering, preventing crime, investigating, arresting and prosecute, organizing traffic control, gathering intelligence, providing equipment and communications, maintaining public safety on land, sea and air.
Analyzing completed police reports to determine what additional information and investigative work is needed.
Obtaining facts or statements from complaints, witnesses, and accused persons and record interviews using recorders.
Obtaining a summary of the accident from the officer on duty at the scene being careful not to disturb the evidence.
Improving understanding and coordinating work execution.
Performing related tasks.

tasksOnly.title: Superintendent of Fire Brigade Grade KB9 dan KB10
tasksOnly.description: Superintendent of Fire Brigade Grade KB9 dan KB10 responsible for the implementation of general management, administrative, monitoring and regulatory duties of activities involving aspects of operation, enforcement, prevention and fire safety, drawing up and conducting training programs, managing research, planning and development.
tasks: Monitoring firefighting and rescue operations in accordance with procedures, overseeing special duties under relevant Acts, and prepareing fire risk assessments.

Supervising fire hazard inspections, enforcing closure/prohibition orders, approving fire safety compliance, issuing compounds, conducting investigations, prosecutions, and arrests when delegated by the Director General.
Processing building plans and premises licences, verifying fire safety requirements, and implementing fire prevention campaigns and zero-fire programmes.
Conducting training for officers, personnel, and public and private entities, and planning and reviews Skill Training Subjects at fire stations in accordance with the Training Policy.
Managing the construction of fire stations and staff residences, determining specifications for fire engines and equipment, and plans the deployment of departmental equipment.

tasksOnly.title: Assistant Meteorological Officer Grade C5
tasksOnly.description: Assistant Meteorological Officer Grade C5 responsible for researching the latest technological requirements, overseeing the process of maintenance, testing and calibration of meteorological equipment, collecting meteorological data and preparing analyses and issuing reports in relation to issues arising.
tasks: Preparing data, graphics, and archives for client expertise, executes wave models, conducts ship visits, manages weather equipment inventory, monitors the Voluntary Observing Ships (VOS) programme, and recruits new vessels.
Obtaining earthquake parameters, prepares data, manages the seismology database, improves data acquisition systems, and maintains seismological equipment.
Examining autographic charts, weather study statements, and station data, inputs data into databases, prepares weather maps, and disseminates NALIS data.
Monitoring radar operations, conducts major maintenance, supervises repair works, and maintains station buildings and radar towers.
Monitoring air pollution instruments, performs maintenance, testing, and repairs, and manages stock and inventory records.
Operating cloud seeding activities, manages logistics, conducts research, calculates and archives data, prepares graphical reports, and maintains equipment.
Maintaining Automatic Weather Station (AWS) equipment and agricultural weather studies, and managing maintenance of buoys for oceanographic and marine meteorology purposes.
Operating WAN/LAN networks, providing system and application advice, monitoring servers, and managing helpdesk operations.
Maintaining computer systems and model control, managing dataset quality, archiving data, preparing annual reports, and producing Synoptic Bulletin graphics and research outputs.

Preparing commercial reports and feedback, conducting client dialogue sessions, carrying out product research, monitoring staff databases, and managing courses, files, inventories, orders, and payments.

tasksOnly.title: Radiographer Grade U5
tasksOnly.description: Radiographer Grade U5 responsible for producing medical images to assist specialists and medical officers in diagnosing diseases, evaluating images and radiography produced, managing matters related to the application of radiographic examinations, responsible for the maintenance and quality control of equipment used, and performing planning, management, training, and research duties to enhance and maintain the quality of Radiographer services.
tasks: Assisting in planning patient treatment and computed tomography (CT) procedures.
Operating simulator machines for training and simulation procedures, and preparing or evaluates treatment accessories in the mould room.
Preparing radiographic contrast agents and administers treatment while managing patient data.
Monitoring treatment side effects and cares for patients before, during, and after treatment.
Receiving and documenting patient information, using and storing treatment equipment, furniture, and linen safely, and adhering to infectious disease prevention procedures.

tasksOnly.title: Nurse Grade U5
tasksOnly.description: Nurse Grade U5 responsible for carrying out patient care and treatment, health education and promotion, patient safety and security, as well as the management of equipment and medications used, in addition to undertaking management, planning, training, and research tasks to improve and maintain the quality of nursing services.
tasks: Providing patient care according to the treatment plan, monitors progress, and documents side effects.
Attending to the physical and psychosocial needs of patients, and administers medications and injections on schedule.
Conducting orientation for new patients, providing health education, and prepares discharge care plans, including dietary and intravenous (IV) management.
Recording fluid balance charts, monitoring vital signs, and providing emergency care prior to the doctor’s arrival.
Assisting doctors during examinations, preparing patients for procedures, and collecting laboratory samples.
Ensuring safe patient care, maintaining cleanliness of equipment, and complying with infection control protocols.
Administering medications and injections in accordance with regulations.
Delivering care according to standards, accurately documenting data, and implementing improvements.
Promoting breastfeeding and educating patients on health care practices.
Supervising patient safety, managing visitor access, and ensuring infants and children are handed over to authorised caregivers.

tasksOnly.title: Community Nurse Grade U1
tasksOnly.description: Community Nurse Grade U1 responsible as a health worker who performs various duties and is a member of the health team who serves the community directly.
tasks: Performing nursing practice, adhering to ethics, and ensuring annual practice is always up to date.
Conducting antenatal clinic, interviews, physical examinations, collection of blood/urine samples, injections, vitamins, and referral of high-risk cases.
Managing deliveries at clinics/Alternative Birthing Centres (ABC), including partogram monitoring, maternal and neonatal care, resuscitation, and administration of Vitamin K1 ampoule/BCG injections.
Providing postnatal care at home, including maternal and neonatal examinations, guidance on exercise/nutrition, family planning, and referral of exceptional cases.
Preparing equipment for child clinic sessions, physical examinations, growth monitoring, immunisation, minor illness treatment, FCM, nutrition, and referral of special cases.
Motivating mothers on family planning methods, health examinations, Pap smear, and referral for contraceptives or health issues.
Conducting home visits for high-risk pregnant mothers, children with incomplete immunisation, special needs cases, and investigates maternal/child deaths.
Providing health education, breastfeeding guidance, infant care, nutrition, health activity demonstrations, and family counselling.
Managing and operating rural clinics, including preparation of medicines/vaccines, hygiene, safety, documentation, patient registration, minor treatments, and first aid.
Supporting nursing training, quality programmes, meetings/committees, community/village midwife collaboration, and routine clinic documentation.

tasksOnly.title: Assistant Medical Officer Grade U5
tasksOnly.description: Assistant Medical Officer Grade U5 responsible for providing health services to the community from the aspects of curative, preventive prevention, promotion, and rehabilitation in the health service system in Malaysia. Provides curative treatment, preventive care, and emergency assistance services at health centres including Static and Mobile Dispensaries, General Health Outpatient Department, and Accident and Emergency Department. Provides early and immediate treatment and support for all emergency cases and refer the cases for further handling to medical officers, provides assistance services in various Departments of Expertise, ward institutions and other programme.
tasks: Examining and treating patients in accordance with Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) and Clinical Practice Guideline (CPG), including basic initial treatment, asthma management, intravenous therapy, and patient preparation for specific treatment procedures.

Administering medications and injections according to protocol, monitoring treatment progress, reporting abnormal conditions/adverse effects, and recording vital signs and patient intake/output charts.
Attending to the special needs of patients, determining special diets, and collecting laboratory test samples in accordance with procedures.
Educating patients on health care related to diseases, and participating in health programmes/promotions such as PROSTAR, health camps, and national/state health campaigns.

Implementing patient rehabilitation, providing counselling for HIV/AIDS, drug addiction, psychoeducation for mental health patients, and dietary counselling for patients with conditions such as diabetes, hypertension, and renal failure.

tasksOnly.title: Assistant Information Officer Grade S5
tasksOnly.description: Assistant Information Officer Grade S5 responsible for carrying out the activities and objectives of the department, carrying out administrative and financial duties in the district, serving on standing and ad hoc committees in the district, and preparing reports and analyses in relation to current issues.
tasks: Preparing and implementing the annual operating expenditure.
Acting as the operations officer for activities and programmes at the division, state, and district levels.
Disseminating information on the country’s philosophy, policies, and vision through face-to-face communication, print, and electronic media.
Supervising the implementation of programmes, activities, and information dissemination at the district level.
Implementing programmes and activities in an integrated manner to foster patriotism among citizens of all ethnic groups.
Conducting intelligence, monitoring, and strategic planning regarding public relations, media, and publicity.
Preparing reports on activities, programmes, monitoring, mobilisation, and feedback from stakeholders and target groups.
Collecting feedback, building networks, and preparing reports on current issues at the national, state, and district levels.
Conducting staff training programmes at the division, state, and district levels to meet skills requirements and departmental objectives.
Preparing reports on training, staff monitoring, and human resource needs in accordance with the department’s Training Policy.

tasksOnly.title: Executive Secretary (Government Administration)
tasksOnly.description: Executive Secretary (Government Administration) provides high-level administrative support to senior government officials, such as department heads, directors, or administrators. This role involves managing schedules, coordinating meetings, handling correspondence, and overseeing administrative operations within the government office.
tasks: Drafting correspondence and minutes.
Obtaining, proposing and monitoring deadlines and follow-up dates.
Screening requests for meetings, scheduling and organising meetings and travel arrangements for the head of unit and other members of staff.
Assisting in the preparation of budgets, monitoring of expenditures, drafting of contracts and purchase or taking of orders.

tasksOnly.title: Consular Officials
tasksOnly.description: Consular Officials serve as representatives of their country's government in foreign countries, primarily focusing on providing consular services to citizens of their home country who are residing or traveling abroad. They assist with a variety of tasks related to passport and visa issuance, legal documentation, citizen protection, and emergency assistance. Consular Officials play a crucial role in promoting their country's interests and providing support and assistance to citizens abroad.
tasks: Process passport applications, renewals, and replacements for citizens of the home country who are residing or traveling abroad. assist with visa applications and provide information on visa requirements and procedures for foreign nationals wishing to travel to the home country.

Authenticate and certify legal documents, such as birth certificates, marriage certificates, and power of attorney documents, for use abroad. provide guidance on legal requirements and procedures related to document legalization and notarization.

Citizen services: with a wide range of consular services, including registration of births and deaths, issuance of marriage certificates, and assistance with name changes and other legal matters. provide information and guidance on consular procedures and regulations.
Assisting in the preparation of budgets, monitoring of expenditures, drafting of contracts and purchase or taking of orders.

tasksOnly.title: Police Officer
tasksOnly.description: Police Officer responsible for law enforcement and public safety. They provide emergency services by responding to calls, investigating crimes and write reports.
tasks: Performing police duties including patrolling to prevent crime and gathering security intelligence, apprehending, guarding, escorting offenders, controlling traffic, patrolling the seas and air to protect the nations waters in order for the people and nation to enjoy peace and tranquillity.
Investigating alleged or suspected criminal violation of federal, state or local laws to determine if evidence is sufficient to recommend prosecution.
Preparing charges, responses to charges, or information for court cases according to formal procedures.
Taking notes, marking and photographing location of objects found, such as footprints, tyre tracks, bullets and bloodstains, and taking measurements of the scene.

tasksOnly.title: RELA Officer
tasksOnly.description: RELA Officer is responsible for coordinating and overseeing the activities of RELA members, ensuring adherence to regulations, and providing assistance in various security and community-related tasks.
tasks: Organizing and overseeing the implementation of rela activities such as security patrols, border controls, and humanitarian missions.
Monitoring the performance and involvement of rela members in carrying out security and humanitarian tasks, and providing guidance and direction to them.
Ensuring that rela members comply with established rules and procedures in carrying out their duties, including the proper use of equipment and operational protocols.
Collaborating with other security agencies and local authorities to conduct security operations and provide assistance in crisis or disaster response.

tasksOnly.title: Territorial Army
tasksOnly.description: Territorial Army fight in combat missions or provide aid in peacekeeping missions and other humanitarian services. They handle weapons and provide defence services where they are required, and attempt to complete missions while causing minimal harm.
tasks: Carrying out intelligence tasks in assisting the malaysian armed forces.
Enforcing procedures of related regulations and laws.
Investigating fraud.
Supervising, scheduling and monitoring the tasks of other workers.

tasksOnly.title: Assistant Fire Superintendent Grade KB5
tasksOnly.description: Assistant Fire Superintendent Grade KB5 responsible for regulating the management of the fire station, personnel, leading the operational and administrative tasks of fire fighting and rescue, managing and carrying out the implementation of fire prevention and safety programs, enforcement and training.
tasks: Supervising and updating fire operations management within the fire station’s area of responsibility.
Leading firefighting teams to fire and emergency sites and prepares fire and emergency reports in accordance with departmental instructions.
Overseeing the use of fire appliances and other vehicles in compliance with departmental regulations.
Supervising skills training and daily training activities at the fire station.
Managing and supervising personnel administration within the fire station.
Managing and executing preventive and enforcement activities within the fire station’s area of responsibility.

tasksOnly.title: Assistant Prison Superintendent Grade KA5
tasksOnly.description: Assistant Prison Superintendent Grade KA5 responsible for assisting in carry out the tasks of general management, administration, finance, research, planning, development, training and security of prison institutions.
tasks: Supervising and updating inmate management from the admission process until release in accordance with orders issued by the competent authorities.
Preparing appeals and Four-Year Statements for eligible inmates in accordance with the Prison Act 1995 and the Prisons Regulations 2000.
Ensuring that inmates’ property is properly recorded, stored, and safeguarded until release.
Responsible for the assigned block, workshop, or duty station, and supervises subordinate officers to achieve institutional objectives.
Leading inmate security control, physical security of accommodation blocks, and overall prison institutional security.
Operating the Integrated Electronic Security System and is responsible for any incidents occurring inside and outside the prison, including during the escort of prisoners.
Performing duties as an Intelligence Officer at the institutional level.
Acting as a Counselling Officer in rehabilitation, treatment, and drug abuse eradication programmes, including urine testing.
Assisting in the implementation of the parole system, delivers prison message talks, and cooperates with other government agencies in the rehabilitation of former prisoners.
Implementing prison management functions, including staff training, control of institutional development activities, and management of prisoners’ family visits.

tasksOnly.title: Information Assistant Grade S1
tasksOnly.description: Information Assistant Grade S1 responsible for assisting District Information Officers/Assistant District Information Officers in carrying out outdoor activities and civic activities, delivering talks and briefings to the public, collecting and developing reaction reports, preparing monthly visit schedules, recording and distributing publication materials.
tasks: Assisting in the preparation of the annual operating budget.
Assisting in managing administrative matters, service affairs, and officer training courses at the division, state, and district levels.
Acting as the operations officer for departmental activities and programmes at the division, state, and district levels.
Carrying out information dissemination activities regarding the nation’s philosophy, policies, and vision through face-to-face communication, print, and electronic media.
Assisting in implementing information dissemination programmes and activities at the state and district levels through face-to-face communication, public relations, and visual communication.
Assisting in the integrated implementation of programmes and activities regarding government policies to multiracial communities to foster patriotism.
Conducting intelligence activities and preparing survey reports on activities at the state and district levels.
Conducting monitoring and strategic planning activities related to public relations, media, publicity, and departmental operations.
Assisting in preparing monitoring and intelligence reports on public opinion and feedback regarding current issues at the national, state, and district levels.
Assisting in preparing staff training programmes and training reports for division, state, and district personnel according to needs and skill requirements.

tasksOnly.title: Islamic Affairs Assistant Grade S1
tasksOnly.description: Islamic Affairs Assistant Grade S1 responsible for assisting in the smooth conduct of activities at mosques/surau, including mosque administrative management, the five daily prayers, and the organisation of programmes, lectures, tazkirah, and talks. Receive instructions and carry out duties in the areas of family development, enforcement of Syariah Law, and Islamic outreach (dakwah).
tasks: Updating prayer and call-to-prayer (azan) schedules and performs the azan and iqamat punctually.
Leading the five daily prayers according to the rotation schedule as directed by the Chief Imam/Director.
Preparing the Friday and Eid sermon texts and delivers religious reminders (tazkirah).
Assisting in managing the appointment and dismissal of mosque committees and the administration of cemetery lands.
Maintaining cleanliness, security of property, and facilities of the mosque/surau, including monitoring contractors.
Assisting in matters relating to marriage, divorce, reconciliation, and individual/family counselling sessions.
Enforcing Syariah laws, including patrols, intelligence gathering, executing search warrants, and attending court as a witness.
Managing the process of conversion to Islam, registration of new Muslim converts, Fardhu Ain classes, and strengthening of faith (aqidah).
Assisting in organising various programmes for the dissemination of Islamic knowledge within the community.

tasksOnly.title: Valuation Assistant Grade W1
tasksOnly.description: Valuation Assistant Grade W1 responsible for receiving instructions and conducting property and administrative appraisals, conducting training and research, obtaining approvals on values in excess of the authority to report them and other approvals on matters set out above.
tasks: Assisting in conducting property valuations and ensures the quality of the valuation process, including opening and registering files (if required), taking comparative data, conducting property visits and inspections, verifying ownership and planning details, researching information and analysing data, preparing building plans, location plans, comparisons, and other necessary activities, preparing high-quality valuation reports, and reporting valuations within the delegated reporting authority.
Assisting in carrying out research studies and continuously updating information.
Assisting in preparing reports for departmental publications.

tasksOnly.title: Low-Ranking Police Officer and Aboriginal Constable Grade Y1, Y2, Y4, Y6, Y8, Y10
tasksOnly.description: Low-Ranking Police Officer and Aboriginal Constable Grade Y1, Y2, Y4, Y6, Y8, Y10 responsible for carrying out policing duties in accordance with the functions of PDRM. Such duties include enforcing the law; protecting and maintaining peace, public order, and national security; effecting arrests; conducting security intelligence operations; managing PDRM human resource governance; and other related duties.
tasks: Enforcing laws and regulations.
Conducting security patrols.
Monitoring static control posts and borders to prevent intrusion, smuggling, and security threats.
Tracking and investigating criminal activities.
Detecting, collecting, analysing, and reporting security intelligence.
Providing testimony in legal proceedings.
Maintaining public order, protecting, and supervising the safety of citizens and the nation.
Providing security protection for dignitaries and public property.
Conducting search and rescuing operations during disasters or for missing persons (MKN No. 20).
Managing human resource governance within the PDRM.

tasksOnly.title: Low-ranking Officer and Constable Grade Y1, Y2, Y4, Y5/6, Y8, Y10
tasksOnly.description: Low-ranking Officer and Constable Grade Y1, Y2, Y4, Y5/6, Y8, Y10 responsible for carrying out policing duties in accordance with the functions of PDRM. Such duties include enforcing the law; protecting and maintaining peace, public order, and national security; conducting investigations and effecting arrests; carrying out security intelligence activities; regulating and controlling traffic; managing PDRM human resource governance; and other related duties.
tasks: Enforcing laws and regulations.
Conducting security patrols and maintaining public order.
Protecting the safety of citizens, the nation, public property, and dignitaries.
Detecting, collecting, analysing, and reporting security intelligence.
Tracking, apprehending offenders, and implementing crime prevention strategies.
Conducting and managing investigations and providing testimony in legal proceedings.
Maintaining security and public order at courts, roads, coastlines, waterways, and borders.
Responding to emergencies to provide assistance.
Attending training and seminars, and carrying out governance and human resource management within PDRM.

tasksOnly.title: Security Assistant Grade KP1
tasksOnly.description: Security Assistant Grade KP1 responsible for performing security control duties of government assets involving physical security, documents and personnel in government buildings and premises including areas declared as Prohibited Areas and Prohibited Places under the Prohibited Areas and Prohibited Places Act 1959 (Act 298).
tasks: Supervising Security Guard duties in registering, issuing, and checking security passes/department ID cards for officers, visitors, and contract workers.
Monitoring and overseeing access control for officers and visitor movement.
Coordinating physical inspections of public servants, visitors, and contract workers, including checking vehicles, bags, and equipment brought into the premises.
Organising, preparing, and leading security patrol shifts, reviewing daily logbooks, monitoring attendance, and conducting roll calls.
Recording key management in the logbook, ensuring all main entrance keys and premises keys are in good condition and securely stored.
Conducting patrols/inspections to monitor Security Guards inside and outside the premises and logs findings in the daily report book.
Ensuring all security equipment, systems, and facilities are in proper working order, functional, and safe for use.
Reporting any malfunctioning equipment, facilities, or security systems within the premises to the responsible Security Officer/Supervisor.
Monitoring and supervising vehicle access control and ensuring smooth traffic flow within the premises.
Ensuring all incidents within the premises are reported and assisting in enforcing traffic regulations on-site.
